title: Senior Backend Engineer - Backend Platform (USA Only, 100% Remote)
description:
Headquarters:  USA - Remote
      URL:   http://close.com 
 

 About Us  Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale.  We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 130-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales.     Our Stack  Our backend tech stack consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our  TaskTiger  scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElastiCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. We have CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to Kubernetes clusters. We also use these images in our local development environment allowing coding locally against all of our services. We have a well-documented  public API  that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. Our infrastructure is heavily automated using Terraform, Ansible and other AWS tools.   We love open sourcing our code and ideas on  our GitHub  and on  The Making of Close , our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like  SocketShark ,  TaskTiger ,  LimitLion  and  ciso8601 .  AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting.   
About the Role  Close runs on Python: Flask web apps, TaskTiger, billions of MongoDB documents, a public REST API that customers and external agents both build on. Four product teams ship features on top of that every week. Backend Platform owns the foundation underneath it all.  As an Engineer on our Backend Platform team, you’re building for other engineers. When a product team adds a new API endpoint, most of what they write isn't their feature — it's wiring: authentication, permissions, rate limiting, the shape the endpoint has to take so it looks like every other endpoint when you squint. Multiply that across telemetry, eventing, database migrations, authorization, and local development, and you get the problem this team exists to solve: make the paved road faster to walk than the trail. Your Mission:

Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft.

As Head of Propulsion Battery System (PBS), you will lead VÆRIDION’s PBS department and hold overall technical accountability for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. The propulsion battery system encompasses the battery cells and packs, the battery management system, high-voltage power distribution and protection, thermal management, charging, and all interfaces to the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the ground infrastructure.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of around 20 engineers, and growing, spanning electrical systems architecture, airborne electronics, airborne software, cell technology, high-voltage electrical systems, mechanical design and integration, and thermal management. You will set the technical direction, build the organisation and its development processes, and take the propulsion battery system from concept through development, qualification and certification to production readiness.

You will also own the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system, represent VÆRIDION on technical matters towards authorities, industrial partners and funding bodies, and contribute your expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Hold overall technical accountability for the propulsion battery system across its full lifecycle, from concept and architecture through development, validation & verification, qualification and certification to entry into service.

title: Commercial Account Executive
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

  • You’re a closer, trusted advisor, product consultant – you’re working with prospects day-in-day-out to deliver immense ROI in an efficient, value-based sales cycle

  • You’re a hunter – you’ll get a healthy supply of BDR leads and marketing opportunities, but you’ll prospect and tap into your network to knock down doors and blockers

  • You’re a product evangelist – you’ll solution Zip to meet the pain points today, but also with an eye toward our product of the future

  • You’re a builder – at a startup, you’re not just a team member, but you help build the team culture and bring your best practice to the org

You Will

title: Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer
description:
Our software decides every 15 minutes what a battery should do. You own the layer that makes it happen: our EMS, the interface between our optimizer and every battery we connect. Whether we build our own EMS or integrate existing ones is a call you'll help us make.

  • Own our EMS integration layer: one clean interface that connects any storage system (inverter, BMS, site controller) to our optimizer

  • Onboard new vendors over Modbus, MQTT and vendor APIs, so the next battery is a config, not a project

  • Commission systems on site until the battery follows the plan to the kW

  • Build our own edge box on standard hardware (think Raspberry Pi on a DIN rail)

You Will Have Fun If You Are

Builder with agency

  • Get-shit-done mentality: you'd rather drive to the site than wait for a support ticket

  • High ownership: the EMS interface is yours, from the vendor call to go-live

Mission-driven

  • Passionate about energy transition and climate impact

  • Thrive in early-stage chaos (e.g. "Can you be in Ingolstadt tomorrow at 8?")

You Won't Have Fun If You

  • Like to follow processes. We don't have any.

  • Want to work remotely. We're in the office 5 days/week, and regularly on site at customers.

  • Want to stay on one side of the wall. This is half software, half hardware.

Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.

Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. The role designs with the final analysis in mind, writes code where manual review would slow delivery, and designs the edit checks and validation that prevent issues before they make their way downstream. The Data Architect is the technical and data lead for assigned studies and works with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Programme Directors, and Product to ensure each study captures the data its scientific objectives require.

title: Closer
description:
Chez nous, vendre, c'est coacher à la décision. 🎯

Nous sommes convaincus de trois choses :

  • Vous êtes là pour sincèrement aider la personne en face de vous.

  • Sa réussite se trouve souvent en dehors de sa zone de confort.

  • Pour obtenir des résultats différents, il faut oser faire les choses différemment.

Cela implique parfois de confronter les prospects à leurs peurs, leurs contradictions ou leurs croyances limitantes.

Même si c'est inconfortable. 💡

Parfois, votre rôle sera simplement de provoquer une prise de conscience et de les laisser partir. D'autres fois, il faudra aller plus loin pour les aider à regarder la réalité en face.

Toujours avec la même intention : faire ce qui est le mieux pour eux.

Si cette façon de voir la vente vous parle, lisez la suite. 👇

Chez NextGenLearning, nous accompagnons des personnes qui partent de zéro pour se reconvertir en Data Analyst et décrocher un emploi.

Notre objectif n’est pas de faire une formation de plus, mais de développer un nouveau standard dans notre domaine.

Nous avons construit un produit exceptionnel, qui permet à nos élèves d'obtenir des transformations que beaucoup pensent impossibles.

Et plutôt que de vous demander de nous croire sur parole, voici quelques témoignages de nos élèves : 🎥

title: Technicien·ne confirmé·e ou Ingénieur·e Conception Hardware - Systèmes Embarqués (H/F)
description:
Vos missions

Au sein de notre bureau d’études, en lien direct et quotidien avec la production, vous prenez en charge la conception électronique complète des cartes, de la schématique à l’industrialisation :

  • Analyse du besoin client et définition de l’architecture

  • Choix des composants selon les contraintes (techniques, mécaniques, CEM, industrialisation)

  • Réalisation des schémas et du routage PCB sous Altium Designer

  • Suivi des prototypes, mise au point et validation (essais environnementaux, bancs de test)

  • Industrialisation : programmes de sérigraphie et de pose CMS, dossiers de fabrication, support à l’équipe de fabrication

  • Design to Cost : optimisation des nomenclatures (BOM) et des coûts de revient de produits existants

  • Redesign hardware de produits récurrents, notamment pour traiter les obsolescences de composants

Vos compétences

  • Technicien·ne confirmé·e en CAO électronique ou ingénieur·e avec 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en conception de cartes : les deux profils nous intéressent

  • Maîtrise indispensable d’Altium Designer (schéma + routage)

  • Solides bases en électronique analogique et numérique

  • Expérience du choix de composants, de la gestion de nomenclature et de l’industrialisation

  • Un plus : notions de Solidworks, développement logiciel embarqué (C, microcontrôleurs)

  • Autonomie, rigueur, intérêt pour les produits techniques et compacts

Environnement technique

  • Logiciels : Altium Designer, Solidworks, Git

  • Composants : Microchip, STM32, drivers, convertisseurs, capteurs, modules RF…

  • Contraintes : température, humidité, vibrations, compacité, low energy, CEM

Conditions & Avantages

  • CDI, poste sur site, au plus près de la production : télétravail très limité

title: Freelance French SEO Content Writer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Freelance French SEO Content Writer to strengthen our organic search visibility and AI

search presence across the French markets, including France and French-speaking Africa.

Our current French organic search visibility presents a significant growth opportunity. We are looking for a writer who can

create original, high-quality French content tailored to local audiences, search intent, and SEO best practices. This is a

content-writing role, not a translation role.

The successful candidate will help improve our visibility across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered

answer engines, including ChatGPT and similar platforms.

Key Responsibilities

• Create high-quality French content pieces, based on briefs and keyword targets provided by the SEO team.

• Develop original, engaging and SEO-optimised content for French-speaking audiences in France and Africa.

• Write content aligned with target keywords, search intent, content structure, and on-page SEO requirements.

• Optimise content for traditional search engines as well as AI-powered search and answer engines.

• Research relevant topics, industry trends, competitors, and audience needs to develop authoritative content.

• Adapt and localise existing English-language content for French-speaking markets while ensuring the content reads

naturally and is culturally relevant.

• Incorporate feedback from internal stakeholders and make revisions as required.

• Maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, content quality, and SEO guidelines.

Types of Content

• Commercial landing pages

• Blogs and thought-leadership articles

• Glossary and definition pages

• Whitepapers and long-form content

• Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

• Competitor comparison pages

title: Engineering Manager
description:
We have real traction and proven scale, and we're now setting up how engineering works for our next wave of European growth. You would lead one of the teams doing it, and shape the practices the others follow.

You would lead one of our product engineering teams: what it ships, how it runs, and how the people in it grow. Product and engineering together are ~25 people, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Your mission

Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own.

✈️ Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly

You'll build and scale the data model behind these areas, set standards, integrate the systems Finance relies on and bring in automation, including agents, where it saves real work

This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll learn how Finance works and why, understand where the value is, and work with the team on how their processes run, proposing improvements and the data and tools to support them. You'll report to the Head of Central Data

What You Will Be Doing
- Partner with the Treasury, Reconciliation and Accounting teams on their processes, priorities and how data supports them.
- Build out treasury data: positions, cash flows and liquidity, as trusted data products the team can rely on day to day.
- Build and scale reconciliation, so that matching, breaks and exceptions are handled systematically rather than by hand.
- Support Accounting with the data, checks and integrations behind their close and day-to-day work.
- Support our corporate finance data partner on corporate finance and investor reporting, working from one shared model and set of definitions.
- Design and evolve the Finance data model, entities and metrics, with tests, lineage and documentation, so the team can reuse and extend them.
- Set data standards and quality checks for Finance data, and build integrations with the systems Finance uses.
- Bring automation and agents into Finance workflows where they remove recurring manual work.
- Look at how Finance processes run today, identify what can work better and connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value.

title: Advanced Compiler Engineer - Quantum Software
description:
Quantinuum are seeking an Advance Compiler Engineer to join our growing Quantum Software team in Cambridge, UK. In this role, you will help shape the design and implementation of the next generation TKET quantum compiler and contribute to the Guppy quantum programming language. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of software development, compiler design, and quantum computing research.  

You will collaborate closely with a small, dynamic team throughout the full development lifecycle — from research and design to programming and testing — with the freedom to think independently and make a real impact.  

Key Responsibilities 

  • Maintain and contribute to a Rust-based compiler codebase.  
  • Develop and apply optimization methods for quantum-classical programs.  
  • Design and implement novel features for quantum programming languages.  
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders across research and engineering teams.  

You Must Have
  • Software development experience, preferably in Rust or Python.  
  • Broad knowledge of programming languages, paradigms, and compiler concepts.  
  • Ability to work collaboratively, communicate technical ideas clearly, and write clean, maintainable code.  
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools (e.g., version control, issue tracking) and development tools (e.g., debugger, profiler, testing frameworks).  
  • A 2:1 or higher degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.  
  • Ability to read and implement ideas from technical research materials.  

    • We Value
  • Experience designing classical compilers and programming languages.  
  • Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum algorithms, or programming quantum systems.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
About Kustomer

Kustomer is the AI-native customer experience platform that turns every interaction into a lasting relationship and a measurable business outcome. By unifying customer data, conversations and AI-native workflows into a single connected timeline, Kustomer helps teams cultivate customers, not tickets, resolving issues faster and delivering more personalized service across every channel. Today, Kustomer is the core platform for leading customer service brands like Sweetgreen, Starz, Vuori, Goldbelly and Cotopaxi.

Founded in 2015 by serial entrepreneurs Brad Birnbaum and Jeremy Suriel, Kustomer raised nearly $200M in funding culminating in a Series E before being acquired by Meta in a deal that closed in 2022. In 2023, Kustomer's founders and original investors, Battery, Redpoint, and Boldstart Ventures, spun the company back out with a $60M investment as an independent, privately held business ready to focus more deeply on AI. In 2025, Norwest led our Series B, bringing our total funding to $90M. This momentum allowed Kustomer to double down on AI-native innovation and build a sharper roadmap for the future of customer experience. Our Krew is a remote-friendly team spread across the U.S. with hubs in NYC and London. We gather in person each year at our annual Kustomer Kick-Off event and always look for Krew members who are curious, collaborative, and ready to shape the future of Customer Experience.

About the Role
Kustomer’s AI agent resolves routine questions, and our support partners handle the next layer of straightforward requests. You’ll be responsible for:

  • Owning technical issues end to end, from reproduction through root cause and resolution, within defined SLAs

  • Writing runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and escalation playbooks for our AI agent and BPO partners

  • Coaching and enabling Tier 1/2 and BP

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

  • Significant programming ability in C

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

title: Founding Legal Engineer
description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.


About the role

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

title: Event Management (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Mittelständische Unternehmer erleben Beratungen meist in einer austauschbaren Eventsprache: Konferenzhotel, Standard-Catering, ein Programm, das in jedem Raum gleich aussieht. Genau dort liegt der Hebel für ein anderes Modell, über alle Anlassgrößen vom Webinar bis zur eigenen Konferenz.

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen. Für dieses Netzwerk bauen wir die Event-Infrastruktur auf: Roundtables, Retreats, Salon-Formate, individuelle Mandanten-Dinner, eine laufende Webinar-Reihe, ausgewählte Messeauftritte und perspektivisch eine eigene Mittelstandskonferenz. Du kommst aus der Premium-Hospitality, aus einem gehobenen Restaurant oder von einer Event-Marke mit hohem Anspruch und willst Formate selbst entwerfen, statt fertige Konzepte umzusetzen. Du verantwortest die Event- und Brand-Experience von Vogel, arbeitest im Growth-Team und eng mit der Geschäftsführung an ausgewählten Formaten.   • Du verantwortest Formate im kleinen Kreis: Mandanten-Dinner nach Branche, persönliche Termine mit Multiplikatoren, Salons mit wenigen Gästen.

title: Senior Prototyping Engineer (f/m/d) – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration
description:
As a Senior Prototyping Engineer – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration, you will become an integral part of our Prototyping team, supporting the development of our Reliant platform – a next-generation long-range eVTOL unmanned aerial system designed for demanding ISR and logistics missions. Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.

In this role, you will be responsible for the integration, development, and validation of thermal management and cooling systems for the aircraft. You will develop efficient cooling concepts for hybrid propulsion components, power electronics, avionics, and other heat-generating systems by optimizing airflow, aerodynamic cooling, and thermal integration. Working closely with mechanical, propulsion, and systems engineering teams, you will ensure reliable operation across demanding flight and environmental conditions.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead the integration and development of thermal management and cooling systems for UAVs.

  • Design and optimize cooling concepts for combustion engines, generators, power electronics, avionics, and other onboard systems.

  • Develop aerodynamic cooling solutions, including airflow management, ducting, air inlets and outlets, heat exchangers, and passive and active cooling concepts.

  • Define thermal system architectures balancing cooling performance, weight, packaging, reliability, and manufacturability.

  • Design, build, and commission prototype cooling test rigs and instrumentation for system validation.

  • Plan and execute thermal, environmental, endurance, and performance test campaigns.

  • Analyze thermal performance, airflow distribution, and system efficiency, implementing improvements based on test results.

We are looking for a highly technical Embedded Software Engineer specialized in Cybersecurity to define, implement, and verify security measures across our platforms. In this role, you will work directly with embedded software teams, system architects, and product owners to ensure secure design, secure implementation, and compliance with defense-grade cybersecurity expectations.

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager you will take ownership of the industrialization perspective throughout the product development process. Working closely with R&D, engineering and external manufacturing partners, you will ensure that manufacturing considerations are integrated into product design from the earliest development stages.

You will challenge existing design decisions where necessary, identify more suitable manufacturing technologies and processes, and drive the transition from engineering concepts and prototypes to manufacturable, scalable products.

This is a key role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product development and manufacturing – and who is equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs with R&D engineers, negotiating with suppliers and engaging directly with people on the production floor.

Comprendere le esigenze del cliente e individuare opportunità di consolidamento e sviluppo delle collaborazioni.  Gestire il presidio tecnico-commerciale delle commesse, rappresentando il principale interlocutore per gli aspetti tecnici e organizzativi.  Coordinare le funzioni aziendali coinvolte, assicurando coerenza tra le richieste del cliente, le attività operative e gli obiettivi aziendali.  Monitorare l’avanzamento delle commesse, gli aspetti economici e le eventuali criticità, favorendo la risoluzione tempestiva delle problematiche.  Intercettare nuove esigenze e opportunità di collaborazione, contribuendo allo sviluppo del rapporto commerciale.  Aggiornare il Direttore Tecnico sull’andamento degli account, sulle attività in corso e sulle opportunità di sviluppo.    Il profilo che cerchiamo   Il/la candidato/a ideale possiede:   Esperienza in ruoli di Project Management, Key Account Management o gestione tecnico-commerciale nel settore delle costruzioni.  Conoscenza del settore delle costruzioni e delle dinamiche operative ed economiche delle commesse gestite da un general contractor.  Spiccate capacità relazionali e negoziali, con esperienza nella gestione di clienti strategici.  Capacità di interpretare le esigenze del cliente e tradurle in soluzioni concrete, coordinando gli interlocutori aziendali coinvolti.  Autonomia organizzativa, capacità di pianificazione e orientamento agli obiettivi.  Approccio proattivo, affidabilità e capacità di gestire situazioni complesse mantenendo una visione d’insieme.  Ottime capacità comunicative e attitudine al confronto con interlocutori di diverso livello.  Familiarità con piattaforme e strumenti di intelligenza artificiale applicati all’analisi dei dati.  Disponibilità a trasferte in Italia e all’estero, senza necessità di permanenza continuativa presso il cliente. title: Team Manager Kundservice
description: Epassi is Europe's leading digital employee benefits platform. We make employee benefits easy enough that people actually reach for them. An app that's always in your pocket. A network of 100,000+ service providers — gyms, restaurants, culture, transport, wellbeing and more — wide enough to fit every lifestyle, not just the average one. And we actively work to turn passive benefit holders into engaged employees.  36 million employees, 50,000 employers, 100,000+ service providers. Local in nine markets, built on one platform.  The Financial Times has named us one of Europe's fastest-growing companies four years running. Backed by TA Associates and Warburg Pincus.  Epassi — Wellbeing that works.   Vill du leda teamet bakom Epassis kundservice i Sverige, i en spännande utvecklingsfas?   Är du intresserad av att bli en del av ett av Europas snabbast växande företag? Vill du påverka välmåendet hos miljontals användare?  Om ja, kom till oss och gör skillnad i en snabbväxande och dynamisk miljö där du leder med tydlighet och värme, sätter kunden i centrum och driver förbättringsarbetet framåt.  Epassis syfte är att främja vardagligt välmående. Vi är en ledande leverantör av förmånslösningar för anställda i hela Europa. Vi grundades i Finland 2007, och 2008 var vi först i Europa med en mobilbetalbar betalningslösning för personalförmåner. Sedan dess har vi vuxit kontinuerligt, breddat våra produkter och introducerat våra tjänster på nya marknader.  Epassi har vid flera tillfällen utsetts av Financial Times till ett av Europas snabbast växande företag.   Ditt uppdrag hos Epassi   Du leder teamet som stöttar våra kunder via telefon, chatt och mejl, hanterar kvittoärenden för våra förmånsprodukter och driver Bike Operations för vår cykelförmån. Du rapporterar till Head of Customer Support & Bike Operations, och tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm med hybridupplägg och minst 3 dagar på kontoret. Sedan i somras arbetar vi i Zendesk, och nu tar vi nästa steg: att anpassa verktyget efter våra behov, bygga en ny kunskapsbas med en chattbot, införa tydliga KPI:er med bättre rapportering och automatisera rutinärenden. Målet är att ge teamet mer tid för komplexa ärenden, kvalitet och förbättringsarbete. Teamet är engagerat och har bred erfarenhet, och din uppgift är att skapa delaktighet, vara tydlig med riktningen och coacha varje medarbetare i takt med att kraven utvecklas.   Dina Ansvarsområden Blir Att     Leda den dagliga leveransen inom Customer Support och Bike Operations, med ett hälsosamt ärendeflöde och rätt prioritering i alla kanaler  Coacha teamet genom regelbundna 1:1 samtal och följa upp mål, beteenden och kompetensutveckling  Planera bemanning och scheman, med täckning vid frånvaro och högsäsong  Driva kvalitetsarbetet: granska ärenden och ge feedback  Följa KPI:er och rapporter, hitta grundorsaker och omvandla insikter till förbättringar  Utveckla arbetssätt och rutiner, till exempel kunskapsbas och riktlinjer för kommunikation  Onboar

title: Operational Key Leader Oslo
description: Requirements     Description & Requirements     Who We Are:   lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.   Job Summary   The Key Leader role is an essential part of the store leadership team, impacting salesfloor team members and guest (i.e., customer) experience every day. Key Leaders are responsible for leading by example and providing support to Educators, facilitating an outstanding guest experience in the store, and overseeing all operations of the retail floor. Key Leaders leverage key performance indicators and metrics to prioritize responsibilities while adapting to day-to-day business adjustments and challenges.   Key Responsibilities Of The Job    Leadership and People Management     Support ongoing learning and development of team members by providing direct feedback, coaching, mentoring, and career path guidance, and addressing performance concerns.  Provide team members recognition, gap assessment, and overall performance documentation to support and reinforce career and personal growth.  Develop, maintain, and disseminate product and general company knowledge through appropriate communication channels.     Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience     Provide salesfloor leadership to team members, including planning salesfloor coverage and making decisions to maintain efficiency and effectiveness of salesfloor operations.   Support team members (e.g., leading by example or coaching) with ensuring a great guest experience that values guests’ time, including assessing guest needs, providing technical product educations, and supporting in-store transactions and omnichannel programs (e.g., buy online/pickup in store, phone sales, and ship from store options).  Interact with and assess guests’ unique needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support.   Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product.   Resolve guest feedback and address guest concerns or escalations to make it “right” for guests.  Move dynamically on the floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team, and guests.      Working With Others     Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests.  Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members.

title: Senterleder SATS Colosseum
description: Vi søker senterleder til SATS Colosseum! 🙌  Brenner du for å inspirere mennesker til et sunnere og gladere liv? Vil du lede et team som virkelig betyr noe hver eneste dag?  Hos SATS jobber vi for å skape positiv forandring ved å motivere medlemmene våre og gi dem en treningsopplevelse som skiller seg ut. Som senterleder går du foran med engasjement og tydelig retning, og har ansvaret for at senteret ditt leverer gode resultater både i drift og økonomi. Du har spesielt fokus på skikkelig god service, målrettet salgsinnsats og et høyt nivå på renhold, slik at medlemmene våre får de beste rammene og opplevelsene.  SATS Colosseum er Nordens største treningssenter med beliggenhet på Majorstuen i Oslo. Her tilbys medlemmene et bredt treningstilbud både for egentrening og trening med personlig trener, samt en av Oslos største og mest varierte gruppetreningsplaner.  🌟 Dine ansvarsområder   Gå foran som leder!   Du får det overordnede ansvaret for den daglige driften i ditt senter og sørger for en livlig, imøtekommende og energifylt atmosfære for både medlemmer og ansatte.   Skap resultater!   Du tar eierskap for senteret ditt, inkludert resultater og utvikling, og har det fulle økonomiske ansvaret. Du jobber strategisk for å nå salgs- og inntektsmål, samtidig som du styrer kostnadene effektivt.   Bygg et fremragende team!   Du rekrutterer, onboarder, inspirerer og utvikler et dedikert team som konsekvent leverer service i verdensklasse og skaper ekstraordinære opplevelser for medlemmene våre.   Skap en kultur preget av kvalitet!   Gjennom synlig og involverende ledelse sørger du for at alle detaljer, fra kundeservice til renhold, sikkerhet og vedlikehold av utstyr, holder høyeste standard.   Sett trivsel i fokus!   Som leder har du ansvar for arbeidsmiljøet i senteret ditt, og du sikrer en trygg, positiv og motiverende atmosfære for både ansatte og medlemmer.   Sørg for et skinnende rent senter!   Sammen med teamet ditt bruker du tid daglig på å gjøre rent, slik at senteret alltid møter SATS’ høye standarder. Uansett når medlemmene trener, skal de bli møtt av et ryddig og innbydende senter.  🤩 Hvem er du?  Du er utadvendt, vennlig og karismatisk, og har en naturlig evne til å bygge sterke relasjoner, både med medlemmer og kollegaer. Du tar initiativ, er handlekraftig og trives med å ta ansvar, samtidig som du har et skarpt blikk for struktur og systematikk i hverdagen. Du engasjerer og motiverer andre med energien og arbeidsgleden din, og du leder ved å være et inspirerende forbilde.    Du har solid erfaring med salg og ledelse og motiveres av å skape gode resultater.  Det er et krav at du snakker og skriver flytende norsk og engelsk.  Du kan identifisere deg med våre verdier: Members First, Accountable, Professional & Extraordinary.  Du trives med fleksible arbeidstider, da vaktene varierer, inkludert tidlige morgener, sene kvelder, helger og helligdager. Dette sikrer at det alltid er en leder til stede i de travleste periodene, samtidig

title: Service Delivery Manager - Tieto Banktech (m/f/d)

title: Client Service Manager
description: Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.    JOB TITLE:  Client Service Manager, Prada   Department /Division:  eCommerce/Client Services   Reports to:  Head of eCommerce, Prada   Job Purpose   The Client Service Manager leads the Client Service team to deliver an exceptional luxury client experience, supporting eCommerce growth and business performance while contributing to a seamless omnichannel customer journey. The role oversees team performance, clienteling initiatives, Voice of Client insights, and cross-functional projects to support business growth and continuous improvement.   Responsibilities     Drive business performance by achieving Client Service sales targets through phone, email, chat, and clienteling activities, while delivering service, productivity, and quality objectives and strengthening client engagement and retention.  Oversee daily client service operations, ensuring effective resolution of escalated client issues and provide hands-on support when required to maintain service excellence. Monitor service performance and Voice of Client insights, translating customer feedback and data into actionable improvement plans.  Partner with HQ and cross-functional teams, including Retail, Logistics, IT, and Finance, to optimize client service processes and enhance the overall customer journey.  Lead strategic projects and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen Client Service performance, client satisfaction, and Client Service business contribution.     Knowledge & Skills     5+ years of experience in Client Services, including at least 2-3 years in a leadership role, with a proven ability to lead, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.  Strong understanding of luxury client service, clienteling, and client relationship management, with a commercial mindset and the ability to drive Client Service sales and client engagement.  Experience with CRM platforms (Dynamics 365 preferred), service performance reporting, and data-driven decision making.  Excellent communication, stakeholder management, project management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.  Native-level Japanese and business-level English required     Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. title: Customer Service Manager
description: ترجم الكلام هذا الى الانقليزية:  المسمى الوظيفي: مدير خدمة العملاء   الهدف الوظيفي:  إدارة وتطوير عمليات خدمة العملاء في شركة تايقو، وضمان تقديم تجربة متميزة للعملاء عبر مختلف قنوات التواصل، من خلال الإشراف على فريق خدمة العملاء، وتحسين جودة الخدمات، ومعالجة الشكاوى، بما يحقق رضا العملاء ويعزز ولاءهم للشركة.  المهام والمسؤوليات:  1. الإشراف على فريق خدمة العملاء ومتابعة أدائهم وتحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية.  2. إدارة استفسارات العملاء وشكاواهم المتعلقة بالشرائح والباقات وعمليات الشراء والتفعيل.  3. التنسيق مع شركات الاتصالات ومزودي الخدمة لمعالجة المشكلات وضمان سرعة حلها.  4. تطوير إجراءات وسياسات خدمة العملاء وتحسين تجربة العميل داخل التطبيق.  5. مراقبة مؤشرات الأداء، مثل رضا العملاء وسرعة الاستجابة ومعدل حل الشكاوى.  6. إعداد التقارير الدورية وتحليل ملاحظات العملاء وتقديم توصيات لتحسين الخدمات.  7. تدريب فريق خدمة العملاء وتطوير مهاراتهم لضمان جودة الخدمة والالتزام بالمعايير المعتمدة.  8. الإشراف على بناء أنظمة خدمة عملاء  المؤهلات والخبرات:  - درجة البكالوريوس في إدارة الأعمال أو تخصص ذي صلة.  - خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في خدمة العملاء، منها سنتان في منصب إشرافي أو إداري.  - يُفضل وجود خبرة في قطاع الاتصالات أو التطبيقات الرقمية أو التجارة الإلكترونية.  - مهارات قيادية وتحليلية واتصال فعّال، مع القدرة على إدارة الشكاوى وحل المشكلات.  - إجادة استخدام أنظمة إدارة علاقات العملاء وإعداد تقارير الأداء. Liderar y desarrollar el equipo: Serás responsable de motivar y desarrollar a tu equipo, asegurando que cada miembro esté alineado con los objetivos y preparado para cumplirlos. Fomentar relaciones en canales sociales: Impulsarás el engagement con los  clientes a través de las redes sociales y promoverás los servicios dentro de la tienda.  Analizar datos: Utilizarás datos para optimizar los servicios y garantizar el  cumplimiento de los objetivos establecidos.       ¿Qué te ofrecemos?       Ambiente de trabajo excepcional: En Leroy Merlin, fomentamos un entorno  colaborativo y transparente. Aquí, tu voz será escuchada y valorada.  Desarrollo constante: Creemos en la capacitación continua de nuestros  colaboradores para que puedan crecer dentro de la empresa.  Impacto directo: Tu trabajo no solo impactará en la experiencia del cliente, sino  también en el desarrollo de tu equipo y en la evolución de la tienda.       ¿Por qué elegirnos?       Un equipo dinámico y unido: Valoramos la confianza, el trabajo en equipo y la  transparencia. Aquí, el apoyo mutuo es clave.  Autonomía y responsabilidad: Tendrás la oportunidad de liderar, aprender y asumir responsabilidades en un entorno flexible y con grandes posibilidades de crecimiento.  Un sector en constante evolución: Trabajarás en un sector lleno de oportunidades, en un entorno que no se detiene y donde siempre podrás innovar y mejorar.  Si estás listo para un reto emocionante y quieres formar parte de un equipo que valora el crecimiento personal y profesional, ¡te estamos esperando!

title: Account Manager
description: Job Description   We are looking for an Account Manager to join our teams located in Stavanger or Bergen.  As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and growing strategic customer relationships while driving profitable business growth across assigned accounts. In this role, you will work closely with customers to understand their business objectives, operational challenges, and growth priorities, identifying opportunities to deliver value through Emerson's solutions and services.  You will become a trusted partner to key stakeholders, helping customers achieve their desired outcomes while expanding Emerson's presence within existing and prospective accounts.  If this sounds appealing, we encourage you to apply.   In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:      Account management. Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with account stakeholders, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty. Develop and execute account plans to acquire accounts, identify product white spaces, create demand and identify green-or brown-field project opportunities.    Customer stakeholder engagement. Map key stakeholders within customer organizations, understand their roles, responsibilities, and influence, and build relationships. Help and ensure the customer achieves the outcomes they are looking for by using your product.    Needs assessment. Collaboration. Work closely with support teams, BDMs and specialists to ensure high quality customer conversations and solution and services development. Assign ownership of complex or long lead pursuit to Solutions BDM or project pursuit leaders. Support and guide BDMs in reaching the necessary decision makers in the customer’s organization.    Market Insights. Stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and stay ahead of market demands.    Reporting. With more than 25 years of conversational AI research and development, we serve over 5,000 enterprises across MENA and are pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through our Agentic Studio platform. As the category takes shape, the way Unifonic is perceived — by buyers, analysts, media, and the broader market — is a strategic asset. This role owns that perception.  We thrive on creativity, collaboration, and fun, where every idea is welcomed and celebrated. As shareholders in the company, we’re more than just communicators—we’re innovators shaping the future together. We are Unifones. Join us and be part of something extraordinary!   Meet the team!   The main aim of our Sales team is to drive revenue while acting as trusted consultants to our customers. Our team is made up of experts in account management, business development, and customer service. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. You will be responsible for managing key accounts, understanding customers' business objectives, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering value through our solutions. Building relationships with prospective enterprise customers through networking, referrals, and industry engagement.    Leading commercial discussions and solution presentations.    Preparing proposals, negotiating contracts, and supporting the sales process through deal closure.    Contributing to achieving the team’s revenue and growth objectives. title: Key Account Manager (Online & Wholesale)
description: Hos Noella er vi drevet af ambitioner, stærke relationer og en passion for mode, salg og vækst. Vi udvikler os konstant, og oplever fortsat stor fremgang på tværs af vores markeder. Derfor søger vi nu en energisk og målrettet Key Account Manager (Online & Wholesale), som får en central rolle i vores salgsorganisation.     Du bliver en vigtig del af teamet med ansvar for vores største og vigtigste kunder - særligt vores online key accounts. Dette er en rolle med stort ansvar og stor indflydelse, og du bliver bindeleddet mellem vores interne teams og vores key accounts - helt fra at et produkt er klar fra designafdelingen, til det er solgt ind til kunderne, og med efterfølgende fokus på gennemsalget. En stor del af dit arbejde vil foregå fra back office / digitalt. Vækstmuligheder, salgsinitiativer og omsætningsøgning er centralt.       Dine primære arbejdsopgaver • Overordnet ansvar for udviklingen af eksisterende key accounts – primært online, men også fysiske kunder. Dette indebærer også nye key accounts og new business.  • Daglig kontakt og opfølgning med wholesale kunder og samarbejdspartnere.  • Ansvar for merchandising af online key accounts - herunder visuel præsentation, arbejde med data og optimering.  • Koordinering og kvalitetssikring af B2B nyhedsbreve, kampagner og øvrige salgsmaterialer.  • Tæt samarbejde med salgsorganisationen, agenter, back office og marketing samt deltagelse på messer.  • Analyse af salgs- og produktperformance med fokus på at identificere vækstmuligheder og optimere salget.  • Løbende opfølgning på efterspørgsel, resultater og budgetter.  • Forberedelse af kundemøder, salgspræsentationer og sæsonoplæg.  • Udvikling af eksisterende kunder gennem kommercielle initiativer, stærke relationer og omsætningsøgende aktiviteter.  • Aktivt salg af lagervarer med fokus på at optimere lageromsætningshastigheden.       Din profil Vi forestiller os, at du:  • Har erfaring fra en lignende salgsorienteret stilling, gerne fra mode- eller livsstilsbranchen.  • Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og har en stærk kommerciel forståelse.  • Trives med ansvar og tager naturligt ejerskab for dine accounts.  • Har et godt analytisk blik og forstår, hvad der driver salg og gennemsalg.  • Arbejder selvstændigt, men motiveres af at skabe resultater sammen med et ambitiøst team.  • Har interesse for mode og forstår dynamikken i wholesale og online salg.  • Er en stærk relationsskaber med gode samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.  • Behersker engelsk flydende - både skriftligt og mundtligt.       Det tilbyder vi • En spændende stilling med stort ansvar og mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel.  • En central rolle i et internationalt modebrand med høj vækst.  • En dynamisk hverdag med korte beslutningsveje og stor indflydelse.  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.  • En uformel kultur med højt engagement, et stærkt fællesskab og plads til idéer.       Om Noella Noella er et internationalt fashion brand med både B2C- og B2B

title: Centre Manager | Business Centre Operations & Client Relations – Central Tokyo
description: Centre Manager | Business Centre Operations & Client Relations – Central Tokyo   Our client is seeking a Centre Manager to oversee daily operations, client relationships, and team performance at a premium flexible workspace in Central Tokyo. The role combines hospitality-level customer service, commercial responsibilities, and team leadership. Candidates from luxury hospitality or premium retail backgrounds are particularly suited to this opportunity, which offers a Monday-to-Friday schedule without evening or weekend work and career development within a global organisation.   主な責任 :    ビジネスセンターの日常業務全般を統括し、顧客や来訪者にとって快適でプロフェッショナルな環境を維持する。  フロントデスク業務を管理し、会員に対して質の高いサービスを提供する。  個人会員および法人顧客との良好な関係を構築し、継続的な信頼関係を維持する。  少人数のチームを指導・育成・サポートし、サービス品質と運営水準の向上を図る。  会議室の予約管理、ケータリングの手配、特別イベントの運営調整を行う。  アップセルやクロスセルの機会を見極め、センターの売上拡大につなげる。  顧客からの意見、問い合わせ、クレームに対して、迅速かつ適切に対応する。  施設の外観・内装やサービス品質を管理し、会社が定める高い運営基準を維持する。  オフィスの稼働率向上と既存顧客の維持を通じて、センターの収益目標達成を支援する。  顧客からの各種依頼やサービスに関する問い合わせの主要窓口として対応する。  自ら率先してチームをリードし、前向きで顧客サービスを重視する職場環境をつくる。  事業開発部門や運営チームと連携し、センター全体の業績と運営効率の改善を進める。  郵便物、宅配便、各種ビジネスサポートサービスを管理し、顧客の業務を支援する。  顧客の入居・退去に伴う手続きを管理し、円滑な受け入れと退去対応を行う。     要件     ホテル・ホスピタリティ業界、または高品質な顧客サービスを提供する職種で3年以上の実務経験。  日本語が流暢で、ビジネスレベルの英語によるコミュニケーションが可能な方。  スタッフの指導・監督、またはチームマネジメントの経験。  優れた顧客対応力と、顧客との長期的な信頼関係を構築できる能力。  Microsoft Office（Word、Excel、PowerPoint）を業務で活用できるスキル。  顧客管理におけるCRMシステムの使用経験があれば尚可（必須ではありません）。  ホテルまたはサービスオフィスの運営管理システムに関する知識があれば尚可（必須ではありません）。  変化の速い業務環境において、複数の業務を優先順位に沿って管理できる能力。  課題に対して主体的に取り組み、適切な解決策を導き出せる問題解決力。  海外・外国籍の顧客への対応経験があれば尚可（必須ではありません）。     福利厚生 :    月曜日から金曜日の勤務スケジュール、週末や夜間はなし

description: Er du vores næste stjerne i grisesektoren?     Hos AgroVision handler det om intelligente softwareløsninger, der gør en forskel for moderne landbrug. Et fokus på faktabaseret beslutningstagning, gennemsigtighed og løbende evalueringer og forbedringer baseret på KPI’er.  Stærke kommunikative evner og viljen til at omsætte ord til handling. Sammen med dit team bidrager du til at fastholde og styrke vores markedsposition og kundetilfredshed. title: Asiakasratkaisuinsinööri
description: Haemme asiakasratkaisuinsinööriä kaukolämmön palvelutuotanto- ja myyntitiimiin vastaamaan asiakaslähtöisestä ongelmanratkaisusta, asiakasyhteistyöstä ja palveluiden kehittämisestä.      Saat päävastuun palvelutuotantotiimimme lisäarvo- ja olosuhdevalvontapalveluista ja pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten niitä kehitetään, tuotteistetaan ja viedään asiakkaiden käyttöön. Seuraat ratkaisujen toimivuutta käyttöönoton jälkeen ja tunnistat mahdollisuuksia niiden kehittämiseen ja optimointiin. title: Senior Customer Program Manager
description: Req ID: 142306  Remote Position: No  Region: Asia  Country: Malaysia  State/Province: Johor  City: Johor Bahru   Summary   The  Senior Customer Program Manager  serves as the primary liaison and commercial owner for designated customer accounts. The role is responsible for end-to-end program execution—partnering with a multifunctional Customer Focus Team (CFT) across engineering, purchasing, planning, and manufacturing to deliver products and services that fulfill customer specifications and Statement of Work (SOW) requirements. Emphasize benefit realization, contract adherence, and scope creep management to sustain quoted profit margins, reduce risks, and leverage opportunities. title: Customer Lead Atlassian Consultant (m/f/d)
description: This Is Us   Communardo Nordics is a leading Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland. We help enterprise and midmarket customers improve execution, transparency, and decision-making with Atlassian Collections and core products such as Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management.  With ten offices across the region, we combine local presence with deep platform expertise, from advisory and implementation to cloud migration, AI enablement, and managed services. As part of Communardo Group, with around 500 experts across Europe, we connect people, platforms, knowledge, and data.   What To Expect   Are you an experienced Atlassian professional who enjoys combining technology, business needs, and customer relationships? As our new Customer Lead Atlassian Consultant, you’ll take ownership of key customers’ Atlassian environments, lead impactful projects, and help organizations get more value from their Atlassian platform. Plan and lead Jira, Jira Service Management, Assets, and migration projects, while also serving as a role model and trusted advisor for our consulting team.  Mentor junior consultants, develop Atlassian-related competencies across the organization, and establishing and promote best practices within our Atlassian community.     Your Profile     Solid experience working with Atlassian solutions, particularly Jira and Jira Service Management  A strong ability to combine technical expertise with business and process understanding  Experience leading projects and working closely with customers and stakeholders  A proactive and collaborative mindset, with a passion for continuous improvement  Strong communication skills and a natural ability to build trust and share knowledge  Fluent in Finnish and English, both written and spoken     Good Reasons to Join Us     Work with experienced Atlassian experts and be part of a highly skilled team  Have a real opportunity to influence customers’ ways of working and create tangible business value  Grow your expertise through knowledge sharing, mentoring, and continuous learning  Take on a role combining customer interaction, technical challenges, strategic responsibility, and leadership  Be part of a collaborative environment where best practices and professional development are valued     Contact   Ashley Hallberg  People & Culture Business Partner  Gamla Brogata

Dabei verbindest Du strategische Entscheidungen mit der operativen Führung und sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Unternehmens. Du entwickelst Führungsstrukturen und Zuständigkeiten weiter und stellst einen bedarfsgerechten Personaleinsatz sicher. title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part isn't the software. Every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that's where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

At Tacto, the people who close that gap are Builders who work at the customer edge. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto, and every new one teaches us something the platform should do on its own.

 

Your Tasks

  • Prove it with their data. Show a prospect or customer what Tacto finds in their own spend, suppliers and parts, fast enough that the value is obvious.

  • Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data, until the procurement team can actually work with the result.

  • Be in the room, on site. Run workshops with buyers and key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

  • Turn the edge into product. When you solve something twice, ship it into the platform so nobody has to solve it a third time. You're done when it drives revenue, not when the deployment is live.

  • Automate your own job. If a step can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

title: Builder
description:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

 

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype.

 

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. They decide what is worth doing, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When it works, they share it, we double down, and everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

title: Werkstudent Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d)

Wir wollen eines der modernsten Gastronomieunternehmen werden. Und dafür entwickeln wir unsere Technologie selbst.

Vor Ort in Berlin · 15–20 Std./Woche · 17–20 €/Std. brutto · Start nach Vereinbarung

Wer wir sind

Nhas City Chicken ist eine moderne Halal-Chicken-Marke mit Standorten in Berlin und Köln. Was 1993 als Familienbetrieb begann, ist heute eine Marke mit eigenen digitalen Produkten – und einer klaren Vision: Wir wollen zeigen, wie moderne Gastronomie funktionieren kann.

Statt uns nur auf fertige Lösungen zu verlassen, entwickeln wir unsere eigenen:

  • NhasOS – unsere Software für den Betrieb: Schichtplanung, Zeiterfassung, Rechnungsfreigaben, Inventar. Beim Wareneingang erfasst das Team Mengen und Lieferschein-Foto, der Bestand aktualisiert sich automatisch.

Zeitfenster, Preise, Zahlungen, Lieferungen, Bestände: Überall steckt Logik, die stimmen muss. Und wir haben noch viel vor. Dafür suchen wir Studierende, die nicht nur Code schreiben, sondern mitgestalten wollen.

title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
description:
THE POSITION

ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory.

This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented.

Missions :

  • Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge).

  • Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods.

  • Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup.

  • Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods.

You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team.

Location: Toulouse (city centre)

Start: As soon as possible

Duration: 6 months

Ce concept unique invite à redécouvrir ses sensations et à vivre le soin autrement, en se reconnectant pleinement à son corps et à ses émotions. Les soins sont réalisés par des praticiens mal ou non-voyants, dont le toucher expert offre une approche profondément humaine et sensorielle du massage.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire Assistant(e) Spa Manager à partir de Décembre - Janvier 2026.

Vos missions

En tant qu’Assistant(e) Spa Manager, vous serez un véritable soutien opérationnel et managérial. Vos responsabilités incluront :

Gestion & Organisation

  • Organiser les remplacements en cas d'absence de praticiens.
  • Contribuer à la gestion des stocks, des commandes et du suivi logistique.

Accueil & Expérience Client

  • Prendre part à la préparation et à l’expédition des commandes (emballage, envoi postal).

Événementiel & Opérations

  • Participer à l'organisation de journées événementielles (massages en entreprise, opérations spéciales).
  • Accompagner les praticiens mal et non-voyants lors des prestations en dehors de l'entrepris

électrostatiques – ESP) capable d’éliminer jusqu’à 95 % des particules fines.

Pour qualifier, caractériser et faire progresser ces filtres l’équipe R&D souhaite
se doter d’un banc d’essai autonome et polyvalent. Ce banc devra reproduire des

électrostatiques de manière autonome.

Vos missions

banc d’essai automatisé, avec un rôle central dans la conception de son système

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

title: Photonic Component Modelling Engineer
description:
About Us

Salience Labs is building an industry-defining approach to optical circuit switching for AI infrastructure, engineered for real latency reduction and cost savings. We’re moving towards real-world deployment, and joining at this stage means genuine ownership over that next chapter, working alongside a highly technical team on one of the most consequential problems in AI infrastructure today.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Photonic Component Modelling Engineer to build and qualify behavioral and compact models that accurately capture the underlying device physics. Your models will be the foundation for system-level verification of systems that combine photonic and electronic components.

You’ll need to understand how a component’s behavior shifts with its surrounding optical and electrical circuitry and with operating conditions.

What You’ll Do

Working closely with the system verification, photonic design, and photonic characterization teams, you will:

  • Develop and maintain models of optical primitives (modulators, switches, photodetectors, couplers, etc.) for simulation and system verification environments

  • Verify that models accurately represent device physics across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners

  • Release models that pass defined QA criteria

  • Verify PDK component libraries so that PDK updates and process variations don’t break circuit-level simulations

  • Extract model parameters from lab measurements

About the Role

We’re looking for a Physical Verification Engineer to drive DRC/LVS signoff for our integrated circuit and photonic integrated circuit (PIC) designs. You’ll work at the intersection of electronic and photonic design, running and debugging verification flows against foundry PDKs and helping keep our tapeouts clean.

What You’ll Do

  • Run and debug physical verification (DRC, LVS, extraction) on IC and photonic IC layouts

  • Debug LVS/DRC discrepancies, including port mismatches, hierarchy mismatches, and device recognition issues

  • Build Python/Tcl/shell tooling to automate verification flows and triage error reports

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

The platform supports accounts payable, procure to pay, and shared service center teams by detecting duplicate invoices, overpayments, and regulatory or payment issues, while also delivering insights for working capital optimization and cost efficiency. With many years of experience, FISCAL Technologies protects approximately £300 billion in spend each year and delivers significant average annual savings per customer. The company continually innovates its high-specification software and services in collaboration with customers worldwide.   Role Description  The Customer Success Manager is a full-time, hybrid role based in Reading, with flexibility for some work from home. In this role, the individual will build strong, long-term relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure successful onboarding, adoption, and ongoing use of FISCAL Technologies’ solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring customer health, conducting regular check-ins and business reviews, identifying opportunities for product optimization, and coordinating training or enablement activities. The role also involves working closely with product, sales, and support teams to resolve issues, gather customer feedback, and drive continuous improvement in the customer experience. The Customer Success Manager will proactively identify growth opportunities, support renewals, and help customers achieve measurable value and risk reduction from the platform.   Qualifications    Customer success and account management skills, including relationship building, stakeholder management, and client communication.  Experience working with SaaS products or cloud-based software, ideally in finance, accounts payable, procure to pay, or risk management domains.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.  Project coordination or onboarding experience, including managing timelines, expectations, and cross-functional collaboration.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts in a clear, accessible way to diverse audiences.  Comfort with hybrid working arrangements, including self-directed work from home and in-person collaboration in Reading.  Previous experience in customer-facing roles within B2B environments is highly beneficial; exposure to finance operations or AP automation is an advantage.  Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

No freezer, no defrosting, no faff.     Our story started with one dog: Marley. Our co-founder Josephine couldn't find a food that was both genuinely fresh and genuinely easy. title: Process Automation Engineer - Internship (f/m/d)
description:

Our service portfolio covers all aspects of metering operations: from electricity meter installation and market communication to data management and clearing.

While Metrify emerged from Enpal, we now operate independently in the market, serving a broad range of commercial customers, energy suppliers, and municipal utilities

Automate the operations behind every meter exchange

title: Product Specialist
description:
Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room.

YOUR MISSION

Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Be the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find.

  • Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts.

  • Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.

  • Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.

description:
