Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

As Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer you will own the methodology, planning, and execution of mixed-signal verification for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago's Systems-on-Chip, working across analog, RTL, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure correct integration and drive verification to sign-off.

This role will focus on the design, optimisation, and development of high performance photonic components for next generation Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs), contributing directly to our future tape-outs and core IP roadmap.

You will work closely with photonics designers, layout engineers, and testing teams to improve the performance of integrated photonic devices through theoretical analysis, simulation, modelling, and design innovation.

This is a highly technical role suited to someone who enjoys solving difficult physics and engineering problems in a collaborative deep-tech environment. You will take ownership of designing and validating opto-mechanical assemblies, including mounts, and alignment structures for optical and photonic components. You will work closely with Hardware, and manufacturing engineering teams as well as vendors from across the world to ensure designs are optically sound, mechanically robust, and ready for scalable production.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role suited to someone comfortable moving between CAD design, optical modelling, and physical prototyping and testing. You will be expected to troubleshoot mechanical and optical integration issues, iterate on designs quickly, and help establish repeatable, production-ready opto-mechanical solutions. Fresh graduates with strong relevant project, internship, or academic experience are welcome to apply.

What you'll be doing

  • Design opto-mechanical components and assemblies (mounts, housings, brackets, alignment stages) using SolidWorks

  • Model and analyse optical systems and tolerances using Zemax

  • Translate optical design requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs

  • Perform tolerance analysis to ensure optical alignment and performance across manufacturing variation

About the company

Braintrust is the agent observability platform. By actively applying intelligence to agent traces and automatically surfacing the most critical patterns, Braintrust gives teams the visibility to understand how agents behave in production and the tools to improve them.

Teams at Notion, Stripe, Box, OpenAI, and Cloudflare use Braintrust to trace their agents, find the issues in their observability data, and run evals that tell them how to improve.

We’re looking for Developer Support Engineers — both mid-level and senior — who are obsessed with helping developers overcome challenging technical blockers to achieve their goals. You’ll troubleshoot issues, identify workarounds, ship fixes, and document your findings to help future developers move faster.

title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Hiring now

We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake.

Role Overview

This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer.

title: Audit Methodology Lead
description:
We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.

This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.

We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.

How you’ll work

  • You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

  • You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
About Virtual Identity

 

Virtual Identity (VI) is a digital agency built on Human-Centered Business Growth: combining empathy for people with insight from data to drive real digital success. With around 140 colleagues across Freiburg, Munich, Vienna, and Porto (and remote), we cover the full spectrum from Consulting and UX Research to UX/UI Design, Software Development, and Digital Marketing — always learning in close collaboration with our clients.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at VI, you sit at the intersection of client, product, and engineering. You're not building in isolation from a backlog handed down by someone else — you go into deep, sustained virtual immersion with the client, understand their real operational problems, and ship working software that solves them, fast. You prototype, integrate, and iterate directly with the people who will use what you build, then help harden it into something production-ready with our delivery teams.

You also bring a well-founded understanding of agentic engineering — not just using AI coding assistants, but genuinely understanding how agents plan, use tools, and fail, and applying that thinking to how you build, integrate, and automate in the field.

This role suits someone who's equally comfortable in a client workshop, a codebase, and a data pipeline — and who gets energy from ambiguity rather than needing it resolved before starting.

 

What you will do:

  • Embed with client teams to observe workflows, diagnose bottlenecks, and identify where custom software can create outsized impact.

title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials.

  • Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations.

Your Mission:

As a Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders), you will own the development of safety-critical electronics for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. You will design compact, high-density mixed-signal hardware that accurately monitors, controls and protects large lithium-ion battery assemblies during charging, ground operation and flight.

This is a hands-on role covering the complete hardware lifecycle: requirements, architecture, circuit design, prototype bring-up, verification, qualification, production release and certification evidence.

Working closely with BMS software, battery systems, safety, PCB layout, mechanical integration, thermal systems, testing and manufacturing, you will turn the propulsion battery’s safety and control concepts into flight-ready, certifiable electronic hardware.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the architecture and detailed design of battery management units, cell-monitoring electronics and associated sensing, communication and protection circuits.

  • Translate system, interface and safety requirements into complete, traceable and verifiable hardware requirements.

  • Design accurate measurement circuits for cell voltage, temperature, pack voltage, current and other battery sensors.

  • Develop high-density mixed-signal electronics incorporating battery-monitoring AFEs, balancing circuits, microcontrollers, watchdogs, memory, isolated communications and power supplies.

As Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders) you will lead the electrical design of the battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and junction box of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own everything electrical on and within these units, from cell interconnections and busbars to protection and safety devices, internal HV and LV wiring, and the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces. Through electrical modelling and analysis, you will close the design before it moves to test and provide the engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is electrically safe, robust, and certifiable.

Within the Airborne Electronics team, you will collaborate with Electronic Hardware Design and Power Electronics, and work closely with the Electrical Systems Architect and the HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration, Thermal Systems, Cell Technology, Safety, and Certification teams to ensure that the design of each unit is fully aligned with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the electrical/electrothermal design of HV equipment for an 800 V class propulsion battery system, covering topology, segregation, protection, isolation, precharge, and safe disconnection within each unit.

title: Velocity Account Executive - SMB (English)
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

Hi, I'm Rosa, Head of Brand at FeedbackFruits. 👋

As FeedbackFruits evolves, so does the role design plays in how we build and communicate our brand. Campaigns and marketing materials will always be part of the picture, but we're putting a much bigger focus on our website, our digital experiences and the brand systems that help us do better work, more consistently.

I'm looking for a brand designer with a strong B2B marketing background, someone who combines excellent visual craft with real, hands-on website experience. You'll help evolve our visual identity, develop creative concepts for campaigns and launches, and bring that work to life on our website and landing pages, from the first layout to the moment a page goes live.

title: Financial Administrator
description:
Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋

Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it.

I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it.

We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. Financial administration can often be limited to a narrow scope of topics within a larger team. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it.

title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
description:
Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive Zip’s expansion into global enterprises with $7B+ in revenue. This is a high-impact, consultative sales role requiring deep industry expertise, a hunter mentality, and a passion for solving complex procurement challenges.

 

You Will

  • Own the full sales cycle: Engage C-level executives, influence stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, legal, and operations, and navigate long, complex deal cycles.

  • Drive new business: While supported by BDRs and marketing, you’ll proactively prospect and leverage your network to develop a strong pipeline.

Du weißt, was Menschen zum Stoppen, Teilen, Kommentieren oder Weiterschicken bringt. Du erkennst einen guten Insight oder einen Trend, bevor daraus eine Idee wird – und eine gute Idee, bevor daraus Content wird. Und du kannst beides: konzipieren und schreiben.

Das wünschen wir uns von dir

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Konzeption, Copywriting und Kreation, idealerweise in einer Kreativ-, Social- oder Digitalagentur
  • Ein sehr gutes Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität, Storytelling und Marken
  • Erfahrung mit Social-first-Kampagnen, Content-Formaten und Bewegtbild
  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, was eine starke Markenidee von einem kurzfristigen Trend unterscheidet

title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
description:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. 𝐑𝐞́𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐝𝐞𝐬 𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐬 :

- Formation aéronautique (avionique, mécanique, système) ou électrotechnique, idéalement BAC+2

- Un réel intérêt pour le secteur aérona

description:
Senior Internal Auditor 

Our passion at SumUp is championing small businesses. We believe in creating technology that is flexible, fair, affordable and easy to use. Every day millions of people around the world dream of starting their own businesses. We strive to help them to do this. Our long-term goal is to close the loop by enabling businesses to turn transactions with customers into long-term relationships. 

We are looking for a Senior Internal Auditor to join our team at SumUp and help us ensure compliance, assess risks, and strengthen internal controls within the organisation, with a particular focus on European regulation. The Senior Internal Auditor will help implement the best industry practices for a robust and proactive internal auditing function at SumUp.

The Senior Auditor will report directly to the Global Head of Internal Audit. This person will work closely with the Board, Audit Committee, key stakeholders and external auditors. This is an individual contributor role. If you're looking for a role where your work genuinely matters and your voice is heard, this is it.

What you'll do:

  • Plan and conduct regulatory, compliance, and operational audits across SumUp's European markets
  • Prepare audit reports, present findings to management, and recommend improvements
  • Contribute towards the development and improvement of the Internal Audit plan, framework, methodology and templates
  • Coordinate internal audit-related projects together with the relevant teams
  • Manage relationships with stakeholders and foster a proactive culture towards internal controls and compliance

You'll be great for this role if you have:

    • Strong audit experience

title: Head of Business Development, Investor Network
description:
We're hiring a business development leader to take over the team that builds and runs our investor network: six associates, one number, and a direct line to both co-founders.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and those investors join our network as members. Founders pay for the access to those relationships and for the investor relations work our team does around every introduction, and that work is ultimately the product we sell.

The two co-founders have led this team themselves until now. It has grown to around six associates, which is past the point where two founders can coach it hands on while running the rest of the company, so we are hiring the person who takes it over.

The role
You lead the investor relations team and report to both co-founders. Each associate holds a book of investor members and runs several things at once, new investor relationships, the nurturing of existing ones, and the introductions we make for our clients, plus the follow-up work from there. Your job is to make that team excellent and keep it at full leverage, which means every associate knows what is expected, gets coached every week, can measure their own progress, and hears it the same day when something is off.

What you will do

  • Run the weekly rhythm, a pipeline and network review (CRM), a review of every win and loss, KPIs, and a one to one with every associate.

  • Coach every associate on their calls and their introductions.

  • Hire, onboard and, when needed, let people go, against a written bar for what good looks like.

  • Own the health of the entire Pairs network, more active members every

title: Investor Relations Associate
description:
About Pairs
Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

The role
We're hiring an Investor Relations Associate to grow the investor side of Pairs: the family offices, VCs and strategic investors our founders raise from. You'll support our senior investor team on live mandates and, from day one, build relationships of your own. You don't need a decade of experience or an investing background. You need proof that you can build a network, a clear method for growing it, and a real drive to learn. The role isn't technical: software and AI run under the hood, so your time goes to investors, not admin.

What you'll own
• Your book: the investor relationships you bring and open here, qualified and kept warm
• Mandate support: investor qualification, briefing notes and follow-up on live deals
• New relationships: regular first conversations with investors new to Pairs
• Your growth: every call you shadow and every brief you write builds toward a senior role

What success looks like after 3 months
• 70–150 investor relationships in your book (150 is the cap)
• At least 10 meetings a week booked between our clients and your investors; 20–30 is strong

You're a fit if you
• Have built your own investor network, through a family office, placement, an accelerator, a fund, wealth management or your own initiative
• Know investors who back US-based startups (required: our mandates are US-only)
• Have made 100+ introductions between co

title: Venture Partner
description:
We are hiring a Venture Partner to bring new opportunities into Pairs, and to grow the network of investors who see them first.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE
This role works across both sides of Pairs. You bring in companies worth our diligence, and you grow the network of investors who back them directly.

This role is for people who bring in deals on their own. You already have an active network of founders who are raising, and investors who write direct cheques. Here you open new relationships on both sides every month, using the same approach that built your existing ones.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angels, not fund LPs.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to founder and investor conversations, and to judging which opportunities deserve the network's attention.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

Your current title matters less than the quality of your relationships. We are looking for someone who has built those relationships personally and can explain exactly how.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • New opportunities. Companies raising Series A and later, brought to Pairs with the context our team needs to assess them.

title: Venture Scout
description:
We are hiring a Venture Scout to find companies worth our diligence, and to open relationships with investors who back private companies directly.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE
This role works across both sides of Pairs. It is for people who bring in deals on their own. You bring founders from your own network who are raising, learn what makes their companies worth an investor's time, and bring the strongest to Pairs.

Most of the work is first contact done well. You write to founders and investors in a way that earns a reply, turn those replies into calls, and bring the right ones into the network.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about direct investors, not fund LPs.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to the conversations, and to learning which companies and investors are ready.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team, on a process that already works. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

This is an early-career role. Drive and judgement matter more to us than years in a seat.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Company sourcing. Founders raising Series A and later, found early and brought to Pairs with the context our team needs.

  • First conversations. Messages that read like a person wrote them, and replies turned into calls.

  • Investor research. Who is investing right now, in what, at what stage and cheque size.

title: Head of Investor Relations
description:
This isn't investor relations at a listed company or LP reporting at a fund: we're hiring the leader of a team of six who build and grow relationships with family offices, VCs and strategic investors every day, and report directly to both co-founders.


Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and those investors join our network as members. Founders pay for the access to those relationships and for the investor relations work our team does around every introduction, and that work is ultimately the product we sell.

The two co-founders have led this team themselves until now. It has grown to around six associates, which is past the point where two founders can coach it hands on while running the rest of the company, so we are hiring the person who takes it over.

The role
You lead the investor relations team and report to both co-founders. Each associate holds a book of investor members and runs several things at once, new investor relationships, the nurturing of existing ones, and the introductions we make for our clients, plus the follow-up work from there. Your job is to make that team excellent and keep it at full leverage, which means every associate knows what is expected, gets coached every week, can measure their own progress, and hears it the same day when something is off.

What you will do

  • Run the weekly rhythm, a pipeline and network review (CRM), a review of every win and loss, KPIs, and a one to one with every associate.

  • Coach every associate on their calls and their introductions.

  • Hire, onboard and, when needed, let people go, against a written bar for what good looks like.

Hozah makes parking automatic. Our cameras recognise your car when you arrive and payment happens by itself when you leave. No apps, no machines, no tickets. You will be hands-on from day one, helping to monitor, maintain and fix the technology running in car parks across the country. When a camera drops offline, a kiosk misbehaves or a site stops reporting data, you will be part of the team that works out why and puts it right, usually remotely.

You will learn a genuinely broad set of skills in one role: networking, IoT devices, monitoring, APIs, databases and cloud systems, all on a live estate where your work has visible impact the same day. You will be coached and supported as you grow, with clear standards, documented processes and experienced engineers around you.

What you'll be doing

  • Preparing, configuring and shipping hardware for new sites, and supporting site launches.

title: 사업 운영 매니저 (Business Operations Manager)
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     토스플레이스의 Business Operations Manager는 Enterprise Sales Team에 속해 있어요.  토스플레이스의 사업 모델과 POS 기반 제품 구조를 깊이 이해하고, 고객·대리점·내부 조직 등 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 실행을 만들어내는 팀이에요.  단순히 계약을 만드는 것에 그치지 않고, 고객사의 실제 환경에 맞게 솔루션이 적용되고 비즈니스 성과로 이어지는 것까지 함께 고민해요.  Business Operations Manager는 이 팀 안에서, 세일즈 이후의 전 과정을 책임지며 솔루션이 고객사에 빠르게 안착하고 안정적으로 운영되도록 만들어요.  도입부터 운영, 그리고 성과 개선까지 이어지는 전 과정에서 문제를 해결하고 실행을 리딩하는 역할을 담당해요.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요     토스플레이스 제품 도입을 위해, 설치부터 안정화까지 고객사와의 협업 여정을 관리하고, 이 과정에서 발견되는 문제를 주도적으로 해결해요.  이 과정에서 다양한 내외부 이해관계자들과의 커뮤니케이션 및 긴밀한 협업이 필요해요.  도입 이후 발생하는 운영 이슈를 해결하고, 안정적인 운영 환경을 만들어요.  고객에게 더 효과적으로 솔루션을 제안할 수 있도록, 제품 이해를 돕는 가이드 자료를 제작해요.  토스플레이스 솔루션에 대한 이해도를 높이기 위한 데모/시연 프로그램을 기획하고 운영해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     오프라인 결제 산업(VAN, POS 솔루션 등)에 대한 실무 이해도를 바탕으로 고객사 관리 업무를 수행하셨던 분이 필요해요.  프랜차이즈 본사나 VAN 대리점에서 포스를 깊이 있게 다뤄보고 운영해보신 분들도 좋아요.  복잡도 높고, 신규 기능이 빠르게 개발되는 환경에서 고객사에게 정확하고 깔끔한 가이드를 제공하실 수 있어야 해요. 이를 위해 포스 솔루션 이해도는 필수에요.  원활한 커뮤니케이션 역량을 바탕으로 고객사의 요구사항에 기민하게 대응하고, 내부 이해관계자들과도 의견을 조율할 수 있는 분을 찾고 있어요.  고객사 운영 과정에서 발생하는 다양한 문제와 요구사항을 정리하고 해결할 수 있는 역량이 필요해요.       토스플레이스로의 합류 여정     서류 접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사

description: Myymäläpäällikkö Maskun Mustiin ja Mirriin   Musti Group on Pohjoismaiden johtava lemmikkieläinhoidon asiantuntija, joka toimii Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Norjassa, sekä vuodesta 2024 lähtien myös Baltiassa. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.  Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.   Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Team   Sets the standard for account management practice across the CS function. Acts as a reference point for regional CSMs on complex account situations. title: Key Account Manager
description: Key Account Manager, Denmark – Nelson Garden        About the role      Founded in 1933, Nelson Garden is the Nordic region’s leading supplier of seeds, soil and gardening products. With a strong heritage, established retail partnerships and a clear purpose to “Reconnect to nature”, the company enables more people to grow, wherever they live, through high-quality, practical and innovative products. Today, Nelson Garden operates across the Nordic region, with its headquarters in Tingsryd, Sweden, and commercial operations in Finland, Norway and Denmark.     As part of its continued development in Denmark, Nelson Garden is now looking for a Key Account Manager to join a Nordic commercial team. The role offers the opportunity to take ownership of an important Nordic market, developing relationships with the Danish leading grocery retailers while identifying new opportunities for growth.     The Key Account Manager will manage and develop Nelson Garden’s key Danish customers. You will lead customer negotiations, annual agreements and commercial planning, while managing campaigns, assortment development and new business opportunities.     Combining strong customer relationships with market, category and consumer insight, you will work to strengthen Nelson Garden’s position and create sustainable, profitable growth.     This is a visible and commercially influential role for someone who enjoys being close to customers and taking ownership. Responsible for the sales growth through campaigns, assortment development and new commercial opportunities.  Identify and develop new business opportunities within the Danish market.  Collaborate closely with Nordic sales colleagues and central support functions.       Ideal Experience and Competencies       Strong commercial experience from FMCG, consumer goods or grocery retail in Denmark, ideally within key account management.  Established understanding of the Danish retail landscape and credibility with relevant customers and decision-makers.  A proven ability to negotiate, build long-term customer relationships and deliver commercial growth.  Commercially sharp and analytically minded, with the ability to turn market and category insights into action.  Self-driven, structured and hands-on, with the confidence to take ownership and operate independently.  A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across a Nordic organisation.  Fluent in Danish and English and preferable another of the Scandinavian languages.       Why Join Nelson Garden      This is an opportunity to take real commercial ownership of Nelson Garden’s continued development

title: Customer Success Manager
description: What you'll be working on   We are looking for two Customer Success Managers, full-time, at our office either in Wiener Neudorf or Vienna. You join a young Customer Success team and look after our B2B customers from their first onboarding to a long-term partnership.    Your customer portfolio:  You own a portfolio of B2B customers, from car dealers and dealer groups to auction houses, leasing companies, and inspection bodies.   High-touch key accounts:  For selected customers, you build account plans, run regular business reviews, and grow the use of our solution across every site of a dealer group.   Onboarding and training:  You onboard new customers, train their teams, and make sure our solution is up and running in their daily work.   Usage and retention:  You stay close to customers across the whole lifecycle and act early to raise product usage and keep them with us. Where you spot growth potential, you work it out together with Sales.   Customer voice and quick fixes:  You collect and structure customer feedback for Product & Tech, and you work with Customer Support, Inside Sales, and Marketing to solve customer issues fast.   Building how CS works:  You help write our playbooks, the handover from Sales to Customer Success, and our escalation paths, and you build our own CS tools with our AI team, e.g. a knowledge base and AI-based automation.   Clean records:  You document your customer activities in Salesforce in a structured way.   Remote and on site:  You meet customers remotely and in person, and you support rollouts, pilot projects, and international customer projects. Founded in 2012 and now operating in 90+ markets, RTB House has always been private-by-design. It embraces first-party advertising and a relentless approach to innovation. Our Spanish team consists of 25 people and is an integral part of our company’s EMEA presence. You Will    Manage a portfolio of client accounts;  Cooperate with the largest brands from the market in Spain;  Meet clients face-to-face regularly to ensure premium customer service;  Create campaign strategies in a variety of industries based on data analysis, your own creativity and client needs;  Adhere to the company goals related to campaign management (i.e. keep an eye on campaign margin and scale);  Respond to customer requests and inquiries in a professional and timely manner;  Regularly report campaign status for the largest clients and provide improvement ideas to the direct manager in terms of cross sell & upsell;  Take care of customer success and long-term relationship;  Provide specific information regarding company’s services and products;  Assist customers in the process of launching ad campaigns;  Obtain, review and process orders; ensure timely payments for our services. title: Key Account Manager - Estaciones de Servicio
description: En Logista, tendrás la oportunidad de llegar tan lejos como te propongas. Aprenderás a diario y aportarás valor en un entorno profesional, sólido, diverso, sostenible y tecnológico colaborando con equipos de alto rendimiento. Si buscas dar un salto profesional, vivir nuevas experiencias y estar en constante crecimiento, este es tu lugar. A nosotros nos motiva que consigas éxitos y sobre todo disfrutes del camino ¿y tú?  ¿te animas a sumarte a este viaje?       Logista  es el distribuidor líder a comercios de proximidad en Europa y está esoecualiuzada en la distribución a canales de proximidad. Sirve regularmente a más de 200.000 puntos de venta en España, Francia, Italia, Portugal, Polonia y Países Bajos. Facilita el mejor y más rápido acceso al mercado de una amplia gama de productos de conveniencia, farmacéuticos, recarga electrónica, libros, publicaciones, tabaco y loterías, entre otros. Logista cuenta con un equipo de profesionales altamente cualificados integrado por más de 8.000 empleados directos y 15.000 colaboradores, centrados en dar servicio a sus clientes del modo más eficiente y adaptado a sus necesidades.     En concreto,  Logista Retail  es la compañía especializada en la distribución de productos de conveniencia de Logista. Esta filial permite a los puntos de venta complementar su oferta principal y mejorar sus ventas y rentabilidad gracias a una amplia gama de productos y servicios adaptados al punto de venta y a sus clientes finales, como artículos de fumador y relacionados con el tabaco, productos de papelería, confitería, alimentación, accesorios de tecnología, tabaco, etc.     Reportando al Responsable Nacional del canal de Estaciones de Servicio,  el/la Gestor/a de Cuentas  se responsabilizará de gestionar clientes a nivel comercial, así como del control, la planificación y coordinación de las diferentes áreas implicadas en el desarrollo del proyecto.     Funciones:      Interlocución con clientes de carácter multinacional.  Gestión, planificación y control de diferentes proyectos  Análisis de ventas, rotación de producto, rentabilidades, etc.  Seguimiento y mejora de diversos KPI's e indicadores del negocio  Detección de oportunidades y propuestas comerciales  Investigación y análisis de mercado y competencia. Trabajo de campo  Gestión, planificación y control de diferentes proyectos  Interacción con diversas áreas internas de la compañía, ejerciendo como nexo entre estas áreas y el cliente (Transporte, Almacén, Bback office, calidad para la gestión de auditorías internas y externas)  Reporting actividad diaria y resolución de incidencias.      Requisitos:      Mínimo 2 años de experiencia previa gestionando grandes cuentas en empresas del sector de la distribución con funciones similares.  Deseable experiencia como KAM en compañía fabricante y/o mayorista-distribuidora. Buscamos un perfil con orientación a negocio, capacidad comercial, capacidad técnica, dinamismo, proactividad y versatilidad  Grado en ADE, Grado en CC

title: Senior Account Manager Grocery
description: Our Global Structure   Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.  Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.  We’re looking for a Senior Account Manager - Groceries to join our  Milan (Italy)  team. In this role, you’ll act as a strategic consultant for our restaurant partners, using data-driven insights and industry knowledge to lead their growth on our platform.  Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.   What You’ll Be Doing   You’ll be joining the  Grocery  team.  This position is based in Milano.  We oversee relationships with high-volume strategic partners, using data-driven insights to navigate the rapidly evolving quick-commerce landscape.   Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like     Strategic Partnership Management: Act as the primary consultant for a portfolio of different small and medium retail partners, building deep, long-term relationships.  Growth Consulting: Use data manipulation and analysis to identify trends, increasing profitability and growth for both your partners and Deliveroo.  Revenue Generation: Drive commercial value through upselling, cross-selling, and identifying new business opportunities within your portfolio. Knowledge of the food retail industry, understanding the unique challenges and opportunities within the grocery sector.  Proven ability to manage long-term relationships with strategic stakeholders and global brands.  Professional fluency in Italian and good command of English to collaborate with our global teams and partners.     Why Join Us?   At Deliveroo, You’ll Do Work That Matters, Solving Real-world Problems In a Three-sided Marketplace That’s Constantly Evolving. We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brough

title: Manager expérience client H/F
description: LUCIE c'est votre nouveau commerce de proximité, qui se donne pour mission de proposer des produits ultrafrais, accessibles à tout le monde, tout le temps et partout ! Pratique et facile d'accès, Lucie ouvre ses portes à toute heure et à toutes celles et ceux qui veulent bien manger, avec une large gamme de plats cuisinés, de salades, de sushis, de pokébowls ou encore d'encas sucrés super gourmands !   Rejoindre l'aventure LUCIE, c'est avant tout prendre part à une aventure humaine, relever de nombreux challenges en équipe et contribuer à la croissance d'un concept innovant. Les horaires sont organisés selon un rythme alternant d'une semaine à l'autre, entre :  - Semaine du matin : 6h30 - 15h00 - Semaine d'après-midi : 14h00 - 22h30 - 1 week-end travaillé sur 3    Le planning est communiqué à l'avance afin de permettre à chacun d'anticiper son organisation.    	Votre profil :  - Expérience en management d'équipe opérationnelle ou supervision d'activité - Excellent relationnel et sens du service client - Leadership, réactivité et esprit d'équipe - Aisance avec les outils digitaux - Organisation, autonomie et capacité à gérer les priorités   Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  - Un poste à responsabilités dans un environnement innovant - Une équipe à accompagner et à faire grandir - Un projet ambitieux en pleine évolution - Un cycle de travail pensé pour vous : alternance travail / repos sur un rythme régulier et prévisible, avec de vrais blocs de jours off consécutifs  - Un planning stable et lisible sur plusieurs semaines - Une politique sociale engagée : 13ème mois, chèques cadeaux en fin d'année - Des moments de partage et de convivialité - -15% dans toutes les boutiques Lucie Envie de relever le défi ?    Rejoignez-nous et participez à la construction de l'expérience client de demain !

title: Premium Services Manager
description: About Thunes      Thunes is the Smart Superhighway to move money around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets, stablecoin wallets and bank accounts worldwide, as well as 15 billion cards via more than 220 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more. Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house SmartX Treasury System and Fortress Compliance Platform, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivaled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments, globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.     Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 14 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, Hong Kong, Johannesburg, London, Manila, Nairobi, New York, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/      About the Role      Location: Riyadh, Saudi     At Thunes, our global network enables the seamless movement of money across the world. As we continue to scale with leading fintechs and global financial institutions, operational excellence becomes critical—not just for growth, but for retention and trust.  The Premium Services Manager sits within Member Experience (MX) and is responsible for delivering a premium, high-touch operational experience to a portfolio of strategic partners. This role exists to protect revenue, reduce friction, and ensure reliability across high-volume transaction flows.     Unlike traditional support roles, this position is highly proactive. You will monitor partner performance in real time, identify risks before they escalate, and take ownership of resolving complex operational and technical issues. You act as a dedicated extension of your partners’   teams—ensuring they can scale confidently on the Thunes network.      Key Responsibilities    Partner Ownership & Experience    Own the end-to-end operational experience for a portfolio of high-value partners.  Act as the primary operational point of contact, providing a prioritized and tailored engagement model beyond standard support channels.    Proactive Monitoring & Issue Prevention    Monitor transaction flows and corridor performance to detect anomalies, failures, and inefficiencies in real time.  Provide early visibility to partners on potential disruptions, minimizing customer impact.     Incident Management & Escalation    Take full ownership of critical incidents and escalations, driving resolution across internal teams.  Coordinate closely with NOC, Product, Engineering, and Compliance to resolve complex issues quickly and effectively

title: Process Optimization Lead
description: Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.   Job Description   You will own the post-delivery experience at Glovo, from the first complaint to the resolution, and decide how it should work. Over the next 12–18 months you will work with the central service team to make one great experience work in every country we operate in, lead the rollout of our AI agent on real post-delivery cases, and own the hardest problems, where keeping the customer and protecting profitability pull in opposite directions. The organisation around you is still taking shape, and you will help shape it.   THE JOURNEY     Own the post-delivery strategy and KPIs (contact ratio, resolution, satisfaction, compensation cost), working with Finance and Product.  Partner with the central team to define processes, KPIs and testing of the global AI-agent roll-out.  Work with local teams to protect complex, country-specific cases that must stay local. title: مدير إداري وخدمة عملاء في سكاكا - الجوف

title: Service Delivery Manager – skab stærke IT-leverancer og kunderelationer
location: Ballerup Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Som Service Delivery Manager hos Atea får du ansvaret for relationen omkring den samlede serviceleverance til en række kunder. Du bliver den, der skaber sammenhæng mellem kundens forretning, serviceaftalen og de teams i Atea, der leverer IT-infrastruktur og managed services.     Det kræver, at du både kan udfordre, skabe overblik og få forskellige interesser til at mødes. Til gengæld får du en rolle med betydelig selvstændighed, tæt adgang til kunderne og mulighed for konkret at påvirke både leverancen og samarbejdet.      Dine primære opgaver      Du får et tydeligt ansvar for dine kunder og kvaliteten i deres serviceleverance. Det betyder, at du blandt andet skal:   Eje den samlede serviceleverance og sikre, at den matcher kundens aftaler, behov og forventninger.  Drive service governance og skabe fremdrift gennem opfølgning på SLA’er, aftaler og indsatser.  Opbygge en tæt dialog med kunden og være den primære kontakt, når leverancen skal udvikles, eller noget kræver handling.  Have overblik over servicekontrakten og håndtere fakturering og rentabilitet sammen med account teamet.  Tage styring på eskalationer og samle de rette specialister omkring en løsning.  Identificere forbedringsmuligheder og udvikle kundens services i tæt samarbejde med kunden og interne specialister.       Om dig   Du har erfaring fra en kundevendt rolle inden for IT og managed services og er vant til at tage ansvar for en leverance, der involverer flere interessenter. Du kan eksempelvis arbejde som Service Delivery Manager, IT Service Manager eller IT-chef i dag.     Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:   Har erfaring med større serviceaftaler inden for IT og forstår dynamikken mellem kunde, kontrakt og leverance.  Har en solid forståelse for IT-infrastruktur og managed services, uden at du nødvendigvis selv er teknisk specialist.  Kan opbygge troværdige kunderelationer og samtidig tage de svære dialoger, når forventninger, økonomi eller leverance udfordrer samarbejdet.  Arbejder struktureret og kan bevare overblikket over SLA’er, økonomi, rapportering og opfølgning.  Har økonomisk forståelse og kan indgå i dialog om fakturering og rentabilitet.  Kommunikerer sikkert på dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.      En relevant videregående IT- eller forretningsmæssig uddannelse, eksempelvis cand.it. eller cand.merc., kan være en fordel, ligesom ITIL eller PRINCE2 kan være relevant. Din dokumenterede erfaring med serviceleverancer og kunder vejer dog tungere end din uddannelsestitel.     Rollen er derimod ikke et naturligt næste skridt, hvis du primært motiveres af selv at arbejde teknisk. Her lykkes du gennem dit ejerskab for kunden og leverancen og gennem din evne til at få andre til at lykkes sammen.      Derfor skal du vælge Atea   Du træder ind i et Service Delivery Management-team med 20 kolleger fordelt på Ballerup, Aarhus og Riga. Her får du erfarne kolleger at sparre med, samtidig med at du har frihed til selv at tilrettelægge arbejdet omkring dine kunder.

description: 職務概要（job Summary）   フィールドサービスマネージャーは、ユニバーサル・スタジオ・ジャパン内で利用される各種IT機器およびサービスをサポートするフィールドサービスチームを統括頂きます。  本ポジションでは、POSシステム、ワークステーション、タブレット端末、モバイルデバイスなどの現場配備されたテクノロジーソリューションの運用を担当します。 Global Technology & Innovation  Global Technology & Innovation（GTI）は、約70名規模・8つの機能別チームで構成されており、テーマパークビジネス全体におけるデジタルトランスフォーメーションを推進しています。  チームは、ゲスト体験を向上させるデジタルプロダクトから、企業活動を支えるエンタープライズシステムまで、幅広い領域の企画・導入・運用を担っています。  主な担当領域には、eコマース、チケッティング・入場管理システム、Web・モバイルアプリケーション、ゲームおよび新技術を活用したゲスト体験、フォト認証テクノロジー、アトラクション予約プラットフォーム、飲食プラットフォームとのデジタル連携体験などがあります。また、財務、人事、購買、バックオフィス業務などを支えるコーポレート／エンタープライズシステムの企画・導入にも携わり、パーク運営全体をテクノロジーで支えています。    主な業務内容（RESPONSIBILTIES）       プロジェクトおよびサービス運用管理（30%）   テクノロジープロセスおよびガバナンス基準に沿って、プロジェクトおよび運用活動を管理・実行。  ビジネスステークホルダーおよび社内チームと連携し、テクノロジーの展開、導入、運用準備を支援。    テクニカルサポートおよびベンダー管理（25%）   現場に展開されるハードウェアおよびテクノロジーソリューションに対して、技術的なリーダーシップとサポートを提供。  高いシステム可用性を確保し、ベンダーとの関係およびサービスパフォーマンスを管理。     ステークホルダー管理およびビジネスパートナーシップ（20%）   ビジネスステークホルダー、サービスプロバイダー、テクノロジーチーム、シニアリーダーシップにとって信頼されるパートナーとして行動します。  フィールドテクノロジーサポートおよび運用ベストプラクティスに関するSubject Matter Expert（SME）としての役割を担う。     継続的改善およびサービスエクセレンス（15%）   運用上のギャップ、再発インシデント、プロセス上の非効率を特定し、プロセス、テクノロジー、サービス全体の改善を推進します。  改善活動をリードし、Root Cause Analysis（RCA）およびProblem Managementの実践を活用して、運用品質、サービス品質、ユーザー体験を向上。    パフォーマンス管理およびレポーティング（10%）   運用KPI、サービストレンド、パフォーマンス指標を追跡・分析し、定期レポートおよび随時レポートを通じてITリーダーシップへのレポート。     マネジメント業務    フィールドサービステームのメンバーをリード、コーチング、育成し、運用およびビジネス目標の達成を支援。  パフォーマンス管理、目標設定、コーチング、キャリア開発活動を実施。  会社方針および適用される法令に従い、管理監督を担う。      応募資格（QUALIFICATIONS）    本ポジションには、以下の知識・スキル・経験を有していることが求められます。    スピード感のある環境において、複数のプロジェクトおよび運用上の優先事項を管理した経験。  エンドポイントデバイス、モバイルテクノロジー、POSシステム、アクセス制御システム、ネットワーク、エンタープライズIT環境に関する実務知識。  インシデント管理、問題管理、変更管理を含むIT Service Management（ITSM）の実践に関する理解。  優れたリーダーシップ、組織力、問題解決能力、意思決定能力。  ベンダー、サービスプロバイダー、外部委託サポート組織を管理した経験。  KPIおよびサービス指標を通じて、チームパフォーマンスを設定、監視、改善する能力。 title: Vil du hjelpe kundene våre med å få mer ut av programvaren de investerer i?
description: Fast ansettelse  By  Vestfold,Sandefjord  Søknadsfrist  2026-11-29  Søk på stillingen  Som løsningsrådgiver Software i Atea hjelper du kundene våre med å gjøre gode valg innen programvare og lisensiering. Du setter deg inn i kundens behov og avtaler, ser nye muligheter og bidrar til at kundene får større verdi ut av investeringene sine.  Rollen kombinerer kundedialog, rådgivning og salg. Du får ansvar for å utvikle eksisterende kunder og bidra til å vinne nye. Du driver prosessene fremover og bruker din kompetanse innen programvare og lisensiering til å identifisere gode løsninger for kunden. I samarbeid med Ateas nasjonale fagmiljøer, produsenter og andre spesialister sikrer du kvalitet og verdi i leveransen.  Hva skal du gjøre?   I Praksis Vil Du Blant Annet:     sette deg inn i kundens behov, avtaler og planer  gi råd om programvare, lisensiering og relevante avtaleformer  utvikle eksisterende kunder og bidra til å skape nye salgsmuligheter  identifisere finansieringsmuligheter, funding og tjenester som kan gi kunden økt verdi av lisenskjøpet  drive salgsprosesser fra behovsavklaring til avtale  samarbeide tett med kundeansvarlige, fagmiljøer, produsenter og distributører  koble inn riktig kompetanse når kundens behov krever det  bidra i tilbud og anbudsprosesser  følge opp aktiviteter, salgsmuligheter og neste steg på en strukturert måte    Du har god forståelse for programvare og lisensiering, men forventes ikke å kunne alle produkter, avtaleformer og tekniske løsninger i detalj. Det viktigste er at du forstår kundens behov, ser kommersielle muligheter og involverer riktig kompetanse rundt kunden.  Hvem ser vi etter?  Vi ser etter deg som trives i skjæringspunktet mellom kundedialog, teknologi og forretning, og som motiveres av å finne løsninger som skaper verdi for kunden.  For å lykkes i rollen ser vi etter deg som har:    erfaring med rådgivende salg og evne til å drive kunde- og salgsprosesser, gjerne innen programvare, lisensiering eller teknologi  evne til å se sammenhengen mellom kundens behov, teknologi, kostnader og forretningsverdi  evne til å forklare løsninger og verdiforslag på en enkel og forståelig måte  en strukturert arbeidsform og evne til å samarbeide med kunder, kollegaer og fagmiljøer  gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig    Erfaring med programvare, lisensiering eller teknologisalg er en fordel. Kjennskap til Microsoft, skytjenester eller tilbudsarbeid er positivt, men ikke et krav. Det viktigste er at du har et godt kommersielt fundament, lærer raskt og ønsker å utvikle deg innen Software.  Dette får du hos Atea  En god jobb handler også om livet rundt jobben. Derfor får du konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, helseforsikring og fleksibilitet som gjør hverdagen litt enklere å få til å gå opp.  I denne rollen får du være tett på både kundene, teknologien og forretningen. Du får ansvar for egne prosesser, samtidig som du har fagmiljøer og spesia

description: Me istekkiläiset olemme teknologiaturvaajia, jotka työskentelemme yhteisen hyvän ja sujuvamman Suomen eteen. Vastaat kokonaisvaltaisesti nimettyjen vastuualueittesi asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta ja asiakastyön toteutumisesta yhteistyönhallintamalliin perustuen.     Haemme asiakaspäällikköä ensisijaisesti Länsi-Suomen asiakkuustiimiin. Työskentelet kuitenkin sujuvasti ja joustavasti myös eri asiakkuuksissa tarpeen mukaan. Tärkeimpiä sisäisiä sidosryhmiäsi ovat asiakkuusalueiden myyntitiimit, joita johtavat avainasiakaspäälliköt, sekä liiketoiminnan yhteistyökumppanit, kuten ratkaisuarkkitehdit ja tuoteomistajat. Ymmärrät ja kartoitat asiakkaan tarpeita sekä johdatat ne tavoitteellisesti läpi myyntiprosessin. Välität asiakkaan tarpeet ja odotukset sisäisille sidosryhmille, jotta pystymme tarjoamaan asiakaslähtöisiä ratkaisuja.      Tärkeimpiä työtehtäviäsi ovat:    Asiakas- ja myyntityö sekä asiakassuhteen johtaminen vahvaan asiakasymmärrykseen perustuen  Asiakastarpeiden johtaminen läpi myyntiprosessin aina liidistä allekirjoitettuun sopimukseen  Erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen edellytysten luominen ja asiakaslupausten täyttymisen varmistaminen Istekin brändin, arvojen ja asiakaslupausten mukaisesti  Tiedon tuottaminen proaktiiviseen pitkäntähtäimensuunnitelmaan, jotta palvelumme vastaavat asiakastarpeita jatkossakin ja toimintaympäristön muutokset huomioiden  Reklamaatioiden tai muiden huomautusten hoitaminen      Saat työllesi selkeät raamit - tavoitteet, prosessit ja työkalut. Tehtävä tarjoaa sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden päästä tekemään vastuullista ja pitkäjänteistä yhteistyötä yhteiskunnallisesti merkittävien asiakasomistajiemme kanssa. title: Entry level Customer Success Manager (€30-€60k salary + commission)

title: Installation Manager
description: Are you ready for a role where your technical expertise and decisions directly shape the success of complex projects? And are you motivated by leading on-site work, ensuring that projects are delivered safely, on time and to the highest quality?  Then join GEA and combine hands-on installation work with planning, coordination and continuous improvement.  At our office in Skanderborg, you will join the Project Execution function within GEA Liquid Technologies. The team works closely across disciplines, bringing together mechanical engineering, process knowledge, project management and procurement to ensure that each project is executed with high technical quality and strong coordination.  You will work closely with the Project Manager, Quality and HSE Managers and the Site Management. Your wider network will include engineering teams, customer representatives, customer contractors and subcontractors.Your role involves supporting the Sales, Planning and Installation phase of a project where required. Alert the Project Manager to risks and deviations, estimate assembly hours and revise plans for change orders, manage non-conformity reports and site audits, inspect building readiness, and capture lessons learned and improvement suggestions.  Supervise installation work at customer sites, contribute technical input through reviews of 3D models and documentation, and take part in inspections or supervision at selected workshops. title: Lead the team and partnerships behind our automated warehouse in Vestby
description: At IKEA, we believe great customer experiences start long before a customer receives their order. Behind every delivery is a team of people, smart technology and strong partnerships working together to make things happen.  At our Customer Distribution Centre in Vestby, automation plays an important role in helping us deliver products to customers in a reliable and efficient way. Now, we're looking for a Fulfilment & Replenishment Integration Team Leader who can help us make that operation even stronger.  In this one-year assignment, you will lead and develop the IKEA team responsible for our automated warehouse solutions. You will also be our main operational speaking partner towards Swisslog, helping build a strong collaboration that supports both daily operations and long-term improvements.  Reporting to the Fulfilment Integration Manager, you will work at the intersection of people, operations, systems and partnerships, always with our customers in mind.      A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US    In this role, you lead and develop a team of specialists who support the performance and stability of our automated warehouse operation. Together, you create the conditions for smooth daily operations while continuously looking for ways to improve how we work. You act as IKEA's main operational speaking partner towards Swisslog, building a strong partnership based on trust, transparency and shared goals.  A big part of your day is spent connecting people, systems and operations. You follow up on performance, coordinate incident handling and improvement activities, and work closely with both internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure that challenges are addressed and opportunities are acted upon. By combining operational insight with data and system understanding, you help identify root causes, prioritise the right actions and secure long-term improvements.  You also play an important role in preparing the team and the operation for the future. Whether it is system changes, new ways of working or evolving business needs, you help build competence, confidence and readiness across the organisation. Working closely with the Fulfilment Integration Manager, you contribute to creating a reliable, efficient and customer-focused fulfilment operation where people, technology and partnerships work together to deliver a better everyday life for the many people.             You're a collaborative leader who enjoys bringing people together to solve challenges and create results. You build trust, communicate clearly and help others grow and succeed. When things don't go as planned, you stay focused, use data and insights to understand what matters most, and turn learning into improvements for both colleagues and customers.  We think you'll be a good match if you have:  • Solid experience from an automated warehouse operation. • Deep knowledge of Astro and strong working knowledge of SynQ, with Astro expertise being particularly important for this role. • E

We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.  Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands, including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure® and Glucerna®, to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.  Working at Abbott  At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. title: Vil du transformere økonomifunksjonen med teknologi, data og smartere prosesser?
description: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.  We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  Join EY and help to build a better working world.   Brenner du for å hjelpe virksomheter med å transformere økonomifunksjonen gjennom teknologi, data og smartere arbeidsprosesser?   I EY Tax Technology & Operations hjelper vi noen av de største virksomhetene i Norden med å transformere sine skatte- og økonomifunksjoner. Ved å kombinere kompetanse innen økonomi, skatt, teknologi og prosessforbedring hjelper vi kundene våre med å løse komplekse forretningsutfordringer og skape langsiktig verdi.  Vårt nordiske team er i vekst, og vi søker nå en Finance Consultant eller Manager til vårt kontor i Oslo.   Muligheten   Som en del av vårt nordiske team vil du jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom økonomi, skatt og teknologi. Du vil hjelpe virksomheter med å forbedre og digitalisere skatte- og økonomiprosesser, implementere nye driftsmodeller og utnytte teknologi for å møte stadig større krav til rapportering og forretningsdrift.  Du vil samarbeide tett med økonomiledere, sentrale interessenter, prosjektteam og teknologispesialister for å gjennomføre endringer og transformasjoner på tvers av økonomifunksjonen.   Typiske prosjektområder   Du vil blant annet kunne jobbe med større transformasjonsprosjekter innen økonomi, der vi hjelper kunder med å:    forenkle og redesigne økonomiprosesser  utvikle og implementere nye driftsmodeller  utnytte teknologi for å møte nye regulatoriske rapporteringskrav  forbedre data, rapportering og arbeidsprosesser  effektivisere helhetlige prosesser på tvers av økonomifunksjonen    Mange av prosjektene våre er knyttet til SAP-transformasjoner, hvor vi sikrer at skatte- og økonomiprosesser er klare for teknologisk implementering gjennom harmonisering, utvikling av driftsmodeller og forbedring av data og rapportering.   Dine viktigste ansvarsområder   Avhengig av din erfaring vil du blant annet:    Utarbeide presentasjoner og beslutningsgrunnlag for ledelsen, samt lede og fasilitere workshops med kunder  Analysere og kartlegge eksisterende skatte- og økonomiprosesser, og deretter designe og dokumentere teknologistøttede og fremtidsrettede prosesser  Utarbeide anbefalinger og veikart for transformasjon og implementering  Samarbeide med tverrfaglige team innen økonomi, skatt og teknologi  Bidra til forretningsutvikling og vekstinitiativer på tvers av Norden     Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi tror du har:    Bachelor- eller mastergrad innen økonomi, finans, teknologi, ingeniørfag eller et annet relevant fagområde  Erfaring fra management consulting, rådgivning eller miljøer som jobber med transformasjon av økonomifunksjoner  Erfaring med prosessforbedring, transformasjon eller endringsprosjekter  God forståelse for økonomiprosesser og økonomifunksjonens rolle i en virksomhet  Erfaring med SAP eller andre ERP-systemer er en fordel  Sterke analytis

title: Payroll Implementation Project Manager – Nordic Countries | Temporary Role
description: At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.  This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.  This Position reports to:  Global Payroll Transformation and M&A Lead    Your Role And Responsibilities   As ABB Robotics prepares to become a standalone global leader in automation, we are transforming key business processes to support our future organization. We are now looking for an experienced Payroll Implementation Project Manager to lead payroll transformation projects across the Nordic countries.  In this role, you will be responsible for driving the transition to an outsourced payroll managed services model, ensuring successful delivery from planning and discovery through implementation, go-live, stabilization, and handover. Acting as the central point of coordination between payroll providers and internal stakeholders, you will manage project scope, timelines, governance, risks, dependencies, testing, and deployment activities.  You will work closely with Payroll, HR, Finance, IT, Workday, and Time & Attendance teams to ensure a seamless implementation that meets local compliance requirements and business needs. The role reports functionally to the Global Payroll Transformation Lead and is part of a wider global transformation program.  The position is a  temporary assignment ending October 31, 2027 .  Preferred work locations are Spain or Poland, although other ABB locations in Sweden, Norway, Spain, or Poland may be considered.  Your responsibilities:    Lead end-to-end payroll implementation projects across the Nordic countries, ensuring successful delivery through all project phases, from discovery and design to go-live and operational handover.  Manage project planning, governance, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and provider delivery while maintaining alignment with overall transformation objectives.  Partner with internal and external stakeholders to define payroll requirements, document processes, coordinate system integrations and data migration activities, and ensure compliance with local payroll legislation and regulations.  Oversee testing activities, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and parallel payroll runs, ensuring defects are resolved and business sign-off is achieved.  Coo
