But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Why We Have This Role

Life sciences organizations need real-time insight across HCPs, patients, caregivers, and employees to optimize content, strengthen field force effectiveness, and accelerate commercialization. Qualtrics connects feedback from clinical research and medical communications so research, commercial, and medical affairs teams act on the same intelligence.

Qualtrics empowers leading Life Science brands to transform frontline operations, customer loyalty, and brand perception through data-driven insights. We enable enterprise organizations to make high-impact decisions by leveraging our Experience Management platform and AI capabilities across locations, digital channels, and supply chains. We are seeking a seasoned North America Sales Leader for Life Sciences - Corporate (focusing on mid-sized organizations) to drive net-new logo acquisition and commercial growth within this critical vertical.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Drive aggressive ARR growth across corporate Life Science accounts leveraging SaaS and Generative AI offerings.
  • Formulate and execute tailored vertical go-to-market strategies targeting key decision-makers across CX, Brand, Operations, and HR domains.
  • Demonstrate a proven ability to originate, negotiate, and close complex, multi-year, seven-figure enterprise land-and-expand deals.
  • Cultivate a high-performing sales culture rooted in value-based selling, strategic account mapping, and executive engagement.
  • Exhibit deep commercial acumen across modern SaaS deal structures, pricing models, and competitive positioning within the Life Sciences sector.

How You’ll Grow

title: Director of Ad Sales - West
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

Join us to build Duolingo Ads, Duolingo’s direct ad business. Most learners use our free, ad‑supported app—so great ads are core to our mission. We’re hiring a Head of West Coast Sales to open and scale our West Coast region. You will set regional strategy, build and lead a high‑performing team, and own revenue outcomes across priority verticals and agency holding companies. As a player/coach, you’ll cultivate senior‑level relationships, shape pricing and packaging with leadership, and close high‑impact deals that both delight learners and drive revenue while leading a team of sellers. This is a high‑ownership, early‑stage opportunity to help define how ads show up for hundreds of millions of learners while building a repeatable, data‑driven go‑to‑market.

You will...

  • Own West Coast revenue targets and forecasting; build a healthy, predictable pipeline across named accounts and agency groups, and deliver against quarterly goals.
  • Develop and execute the regional go‑to‑market strategy, including territory design, vertical focus, pricing/packaging inputs, and coverage plans as we scale.
  • Hire, coach, and lead a small team of sellers over time; establish operating rhythms, deal reviews, and CRM hygiene standards that improve forecast accuracy and execution.
  • Build and deepen senior relationships at brands and agencies; open new logos and expand strategic accounts with clear commercial narratives that map Duolingo’s unique strengths (design, IP, native formats) to client objectives.
  • Lead complex deals end‑to‑end—from prospecting and positioning through negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion—partnering tightly with Account Management and Ad Ops for flawless delivery.
  • Share actionable market feedback with sales and product leadership to inform pricing, packaging, measurement, and ad experiences while protecting the learner experience.
  • Operate with speed and rigor in a startup‑like environment, building repeatable sales

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Deepgram is looking for an Inbound Sales Development Representative to drive new customers and revenue to our rapidly growing company. You will create sales opportunities for Deepgram as you share our mission with CTOs, VPs of Product, and CEOs. You are a critical component in Deepgram’s Revenue organization and will play a pivotal role in growing our top-line revenue to new heights!

What You'll Do

  • Work with our Partnerships team, Account Executives, and your fellow SDRs to build a strong sales pipeline of new logos, striving to exceed quarterly sales targets

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (especially Sales Ops and Sales Engineers) to ensure sales effectiveness

  • Have a depth of understanding regarding customer needs in the ASR space, competition, and Deepgram products to be able to fully articulate our value proposition

  • Research companies to find new speech reco

description:
At Archive, we believe great products should live many lives. We build the technology that powers branded resale for some of the world’s most beloved companies, including Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance, Dr. Martens, Peloton, and 50+ others. Our platform makes it easy for brands to keep products in circulation and for customers to shop secondhand with confidence.

The secondhand market is growing three times faster than traditional retail and is projected to reach $350B globally by 2028. We’re building the infrastructure behind that shift, helping brands turn resale into a meaningful part of their business and helping consumers rethink how they shop. If you’re excited to change consumer behavior for the better, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Sr. Manager of Account-Based Marketing to own how Archive gets in front of the brands we want to work with, and to build the system that engineers that outcome at the account level, not just the individual outreach level.

This isn't a broad-funnel ABM role. Our current TAM is roughly 300 named brands across apparel, footwear, children's bikes, and kitchen supplies. There is no "tier 3, spray-and-pray" segment here. Every account matters, every buying committee is knowable, and the job is to be the sharpest, best-informed presence in the room before an AE ever gets on the phone. Precision, brand craft, and creativity are what win at Archive. That's where you come in.

This is a role for someone who can map an entire buying committee at a target brand, know who owns the customer acquisition number, who owns the brand and full-price growth, who evaluates operational lift, and where sustainability sits in the decision.

Responsibilities

  • Own the number. You'll carry the account-based marketing target; meetings held and opportunities created across our named account list, forecast it accurately, and report progress account by account, not just in aggregate. You'll also own the leading indicators that predict those outcomes; how deep we've penetrated each buying committee, and whether our core business case is actually landing in the accounts we're working.

  • Own the account universe. ~300 target accounts, segmented by brand type and firmographics, each defined buying committee (CFO & CMO as economic buyer and strategic sponsor; VP Ecomm; Ops & Sustainability as influencers and technical evaluators) and a play built for that specific group. Priority accounts get 1:1 orchestration; mid-tier gets 1:few cluster plays; the long tail gets scaled-but-still-personal sequencing. Every account is AE-owned, so tight, constant coordination with the sales team is critical.

  • Monitor signals, don't wait for them. This is the core shift from a traditional demand-gen

description:
About Humify GmbH

Humify is an innovative start-up developing a novel technology to convert biomass into valuable humic substances. Our mission is to improve soil fertility, support sustainable agriculture, and contribute to long-term carbon storage.

We are a small, international team of scientists and engineers working to bring this technology from the laboratory to industrial production.

The Position

We are looking for a hands-on person to support the operation, maintenance, and optimization of our small-scale extrusion equipment for biomass conversion.

You will work directly with our engineers and scientists to prepare experiments, operate the extruder, modify equipment, and ensure that our experimental processes run safely and reliably.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys practical technical work, solving mechanical problems, and experimenting with new technologies.

  • Equipment operation: Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain a laboratory- or pilot-scale extruder for biomass processing.

  • Maintenance and troubleshooting: Identify and resolve mechanical and operational problems, perform routine maintenance, and minimize equipment downtime.

  • Process monitoring: Monitor operating parameters such as temperature, pressure, screw speed, feed rate, and material flow.

  • Workshop activities: Support the construction of prototypes, installation of sensors, and modification of experimental equipment.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

description:
Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting and creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. This means you’ll devise the strategy, planning, and execution of Substack's brand events portfolio in the UK whilst simultaneously building the framework for our growing international activity, from flagship brand moments in London to intimate creator gatherings in Sydney.

 

You’ll create meaningful brand and creator events that are genuinely creative, unique and fun to attend, help foster our community of bestsellers and attract more people to join Substack, and show people they are part of something truly special by being part of our platform. You'll work at the intersection of culture, technology, and media, partnering with some of the most interesting voices shaping our world, across the ideological spectrum.

 

This role reports to the Head of Communications & Brand and is based in London.

title: Analog Layout Engineer (Lead)
description:
At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

 

Kandou’s architecture is not just an incremental improvement — it’s a foundational shift in how AI hardware is built for the future.

  • Position in custom layout and verification of analog circuits, cells, blocks, and IP for multi-Gigabit high speed chip to chip communication links (SerDes up to and beyond 28Gb/s and/or memory IO) in advanced semiconductor technology nodes

  • Vous habitez à Nanterre ou dans l'ouest parisien (Hauts-de-Seine, Yvelines, Val-d'Oise, ouest de Paris).

title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
description:
TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. 

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. 

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. 

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself.

title: Product Manager – Traffic (Flow, Jams, Speed Profiles & Moderation)
description:
Introduction
Real-time traffic is at the heart of TomTom's mission to engineer the smartest, most useful map on the planet. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage.
As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap.

What you'll do
  • Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality.
  • Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog.
  • Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively.
  • Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage.
  • Lead brainstorms and drive product exploration through prototypes and wireframes.
  • Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves.

  Carrot  is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at  get-carrot.com .    The Opportunity     
 Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time to full-time, fully remote Registered Nurses who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across all U.S. states. As an RN in this network, you are often the first clinical touchpoint for members navigating fertility, menopause, hormonal, and metabolic health journeys, providing triage, education, care coordination, and documentation that shape the entire care experience. 
 All work in this role is performed within RN scope of practice. RNs provide triage, education, care coordination, and documentation; they do not diagnose, do not prescribe, and do not independently modify a treatment plan.  Review and triage incoming lab results, escalate critical findings per protocol, retrieve outside records, and coordinate specialist referrals. 
 Manage pharmacy callbacks and prior authorizations in coordination with the care team.

  What You’ll Own     
 In this role, you will: 
 
 Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns. 
 Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making. 
 Assess and manage metabolic health as a routine part of visits, including prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications such as GLP-1 receptor agonists within clinical protocols where appropriate. 
 Document visits accurately and on time, order and interpret relevant labs

title: Database Engineering Intern
description:
We are looking for a Database Engineering Intern to work on the data layer of our production software. You will work alongside the developer who owns our data layer on data modelling, query optimisation and documentation.

Our stack is PostgreSQL, Supabase, PostgREST and row-level security, with TypeScript, React, Vite, Vitest, Deno edge functions and GitHub Actions around it. Every change goes through a pull request with automated type, lint, format, build and test checks.

  • Improve our data models: reduce duplicated values and work with references and views.

  • Measure query performance and add indexes where they make a difference.

  • Review our database access policies.

Requirements

  • You are studying computer science, data engineering or something similar.

  • Comfortable in SQL: joins, aggregates, indexes, and reading a query plan.

  • You are happy to spend time reading existing code before changing it.

  • PostgreSQL specifics (indexing strategies, EXPLAIN, constraints, triggers) and experience with Supabase or a similar API-over-Postgres layer are a plus.

  • Coursework or a project in data modelling and normalisation.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools.

title: Head of Research & Editorial
description:
About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, and London and Dubai opening this year.

Why this role

Frontline labour markets are badly measured. Governments publish unemployment and vacancy statistics. Nobody publishes a credible number for how long it takes to get a qualified person from application to first shift, what that delay costs, or how much of it is regulatory rather than operational.

We see activation at scale, across sectors and jurisdictions, so we can measure what nobody else can. Publishing it sets the terms of the debate, gives policymakers something real to work with, and gives our commercial teams something better than a pitch deck. The standard we are aiming at is work a member of government or tier one investor forwards along to their colleagues.

What you'll do

  • Set the research agenda

  • Write and publish flagship reports and white papers

  • Own editorial standards across everything Firstwork publishes

  • Build data stories with our data and engineering teams

  • Lead policy engagement on European labour and employment regulat

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once:

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

Je onderhoudt relaties met klanten op verschillende niveaus binnen hun organisatie, met de focus op klanttevredenheid, -behoud en groei van de portefeuille. Je zorgt voor omzetgroei door upsell/cross-sell en analyseert zowel klantdoelstellingen als die van je eigen organisatie om deze te bereiken.     Je fungeert als eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en wijst hen op beschikbare resources, zoals kennisbanken, trainingen en handleidingen. Daarnaast monitor je de opvolging van taken, ondersteund door de binnendienst, en analyseer je klantfeedback om producten en klanttevredenheid te verbeteren. Je onderhoudt nauw contact met klanten en interne opdrachtverantwoordelijken, zoals de Lead of Project Manager.     Je bent alert op ontwikkelingen bij klanten die kunnen leiden tot het reduceren of beëindigen van de dienstverlening en onderneemt initiatieven om klanttevredenheid te verbeteren waar nodig. Je houdt jezelf op de hoogte van relevante trends, ontwikkelingen in de markt, productkennis en processen. description: Functieomschrijving   Dankzij de diensten van Logius kunnen burgers inloggen met DigiD, hun gegevens bekijken in MijnOverheid en kunnen overheidsorganisaties veilig en betrouwbaar gegevens met elkaar uitwisselen. Achter deze digitale dienstverlening gaat een complexe IT-keten schuil, waarin continuïteit, kwaliteit en samenwerking essentieel zijn. Als Servicemanager IT bij Logius zorg jij ervoor dat deze dienstverlening betrouwbaar blijft functioneren en zich verder kan ontwikkelen. Je overziet het geheel, verbindt verschillende partijen en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen. Zo lever je in Den Haag een belangrijke bijdrage aan een digitale overheid die werkt voor iedereen.    Jouw uitdaging als Servicemanager IT? Zorgen voor betrouwbare dienstverlening in een complexe IT-keten   Als Servicemanager IT Ga Je Aan De Slag Binnen De Directie Productiehuis, In De ART Gegevensgebruik. Binnen Deze ART Werken Verschillende Teams Aan Voorzieningen Waarmee Overheidsorganisaties Gegevens Met Elkaar Kunnen Uitwisselen En Gebruiken. Denk Bijvoorbeeld Aan    Digilevering: levert gebeurtenissen uit overheidsregistraties aan aangesloten afnemers;  Digimelding: biedt organisaties de mogelijkheid om fouten in basisregistraties te melden en te corrigeren;  COR/OIN: ondersteunt betrouwbare gegevensuitwisseling met een register en identificatienummers voor organisaties.    De diensten worden gebruikt door onder andere gemeenten, overheids- en uitvoeringsorganisaties en ketenpartners. Hoewel burgers niet rechtstreeks gebruikmaken van deze voorzieningen, zijn ze wel belangrijk voor allerlei overheidsprocessen en uiteindelijk voor de dienstverlening aan burgers en bedrijven.  Als Servicemanager IT ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en continuïteit van één of meerdere diensten binnen deze ART. Je werkt volgens de SAFe-methodiek, in een omgeving waarin Agile- en DevOps-teams in sprints van twee weken samenwerken aan beheer en doorontwikkeling. Samen met de Product Owner en de verschillende teams zorg je ervoor dat de dienstverlening aansluit op de gemaakte afspraken en verwachtingen van afnemers en leveranciers. Je houdt daarbij niet alleen zicht op de dagelijkse dienstverlening, maar kijkt ook vooruit. Binnen de ART Gegevensgebruik staan de komende jaren verschillende veranderingen op de agenda. Denk aan het uitfaseren van bestaande systemen, het terugdringen van technische schuld en de migratie naar het Logius Platform Common (LPC). Ook wordt gewerkt aan het opbouwen van een Configuration Management Database (CMDB) en het verbeteren van processen rondom forecasting en lifecyclemanagement. Als IT Servicemanager speel je een belangrijke rol bij het beheerst uitvoeren van deze veranderingen, waarbij je steeds de balans bewaakt tussen vernieuwing en continuïteit. Teile Best Practices, Marktkenntnisse und Datenanalysen, um den Kundenerfolg und die Kundenbindung zu stärken. Ein gutes Verständnis für kommerzielle Zusammenhänge, Technologie und digitale Lernlösungen.  Eine kundenorientierte, lösungsorientierte und datenbasierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, auch unter Druck souverän zu handeln.  Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Freude an einer offenen Feedbackkultur. We welcome high performers who thrive in dynamic, client-focused environments.     At Cobase, we’re helping companies take back control of their banking and treasury operations.  Many mid-sized and large businesses manage multiple banks, dozens of accounts, and complex finance structures often spread across countries, currencies, and entities. It’s messy, inefficient, and hard to manage. That’s where we come in.  Cobase offers a single platform where finance teams can handle payments, cash management, and other treasury functionality all connected to their ERP or accounting system. No more jumping between portals or spreadsheets. The role: help our customers hit the ground running.   We’re looking for a Bank Implementation Manager to join our team and lead clients through onboarding and setup. We value proactive, high-performing professionals who thrive in dynamic environments.  In this role, you’ll partner with banks to ensure Cobase is up and running quickly connecting banks, configuring payments and reporting, and establishing payment products. What we are looking for:    Result-oriented mindset with a “get things done” approach  Strong communication skills and a structured way of working  Fluent in English and at least one other language  Comfortable working with technology, banking, or finance tools  Ability to engage confidently with both IT and Finance stakeholders  Prior experience in treasury, payments, ERP, or financial implementation is a strong advantage  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience  Hands-on, proactive, and eager to take ownership       Must to have EU citizenship with the right to work in the Netherlands.

Un communiqué se lit désormais autant dans les réponses de ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity ou Gemini que dans la presse. Notre travail consiste donc à certifier l'information à la source, pour qu'elle reste vérifiable quand les contenus synthétiques saturent tout, et à optimiser la visibilité et réputation de nos clients dans les moteurs génératifs. C'est ce qu'on appelle le GEO, et c'est là que nous accélérons.  Nous sommes une trentaine à Paris. Peu d'intermédiaires entre une idée et sa mise en production, et un impact visible tout de suite chez des marques que tout le monde connaît.  En tant que Customer Success Manager, tu es le  business owner de la relation client après la signature.  Tu prends un portefeuille de comptes stratégiques avec une mission simple : qu'ils réussissent, qu'ils restent, qu'ils grandissent. La rétention comme la croissance de tes comptes, c'est toi, de bout en bout, avec l'IA comme copilote au quotidien.  On te confie de l'autonomie et des comptes majeurs. En échange, on attend le niveau d'exigence que nos clients ont envers nous : comprendre vite, décider juste, faire avancer les choses.  Si tu aimes transformer des situations complexes en réussites durables et voir ton impact après semaine, ce poste est fait pour toi.   Tes missions   Ton rôle combine relation client, conseil stratégique, pilotage de projets, analyse de données et développement commercial.    Être propriétaire de la relation avec un portefeuille de  comptes stratégiques,  en tant qu'interlocuteur de référence au quotidien, du chat Intercom et aux échanges avec leurs dirigeants.    Guider tes clients à travers  l'onboarding pour assurer une adoption  forte de Wiztrust.    Analyser la  performance de chaque compte et formuler des recommandations  claires et actionnables pour améliorer leurs résultats.    Identifier les  opportunités d'élargir la collaboration  — adoption plus large de la plateforme, nouveaux investissements — et les mener jusqu'à la signature.    Suivre la santé de tes comptes,  anticiper les risques et sécuriser chaque renouvellement  en position de force.     Collaborer  avec le Produit, la Tech, le Marketing et la Direction pour résoudre les sujets clients et renforcer la valeur de la plateforme.     Utiliser l'IA comme un outil de travail  pour gagner en efficacité, analyser les informations et améliorer la qualité de l'accompagnement.    Participer à la création de processus et de bonnes pratiques pour faire  évoluer et scaler l'équipe Customer Success.        Réussir dans ce poste, c'est      Tenir et faire progresser le revenu de ton portefeuille

title: Customer Service Manager
location: Haderslev, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Leder af genbrugs- og kundevejledere med fokus på mennesker, drift og borgeroplevelser    ReQT Consulting søger for Provas Forsyningsservice A/S - Haderslev kommunes forsyningsselskab       Vil du stå i spidsen for en vigtig kundeservicefunktion, hvor mennesker, ledelse og samfundsansvar går hånd i hånd?      Hos Provas får du muligheden for at sætte retningen for en kundeservicefunktion med stor betydning for både borgere, medarbejdere og den daglige drift. Du bliver leder for den kundeservice og -vejledning som sker ved telefonen og pr. mail samt på genbrugspladserne – og du får en central rolle i at skabe fællesskab, struktur og stærke samarbejder på tværs.     Vi søger en nærværende, kompetent og tydelig leder, der trives i arbejdet med mennesker, motiveres af udvikling og formår at skabe følgeskab i ”medledende” teams. Du bliver en del af et stærkt ledelsesfællesskab i en organisation med højt engagement, stor samfundsmæssig betydning og fokus på at skabe den bedst mulige oplevelse for borgerne (som vi også kalder kunderne).         Er du vores nye kollega?   Vi forestiller os, at du kommer fra en rolle, hvor du har arbejdet med ledelse og kundeservice tæt på en drift- eller serviceorganisation. Du er nysgerrig og motiveres af at få mennesker, samarbejder og processer til at fungere i praksis og trives i en rolle med mange kontaktflader.  Som leder skaber du tillid og følgeskab gennem tydelig kommunikation, involvering og nærvær. Du evner at lade medarbejderne bringe deres kompetencer i spil, hvor du understøtter gennem afbalanceret retnings- og rammesætning, når situationen kræver det. Du arbejder coachende og faciliterende og formår at skabe struktur, engagement og stærke fællesskaber.  Derudover har du erfaring med ledelse, interesse for adfærdsdesign og brugeradfærd samt lyst til at arbejde i en organisation præget af udvikling, forandringer og med fokus på den gode borgeroplevelse. Du kommer til at indgå i et stærkt lederfællesskab på tværs af virksomheden, hvor vi sammen tager ansvar for helheden.         Om Provas   Provas er Haderslev Kommunes forsyningsselskab, der leverer drikkevand og håndterer spildevand, affald og genbrug for kommunens 56.000 indbyggere. Indsatserne har stor betydning for fremtidige generationer ved at sikre et bæredygtig vandkredsløb og genbrug af ressourcer.     Provas er en moderne virksomhed med godt 80 ansatte. Omkring halvdelen arbejder i den fysiske drift, og resten arbejder overvejende på kontoret. Der er et fladt hierarki, så i dagligdagen er topledelse ikke et tydeligt begreb. Ledelsesstilen hos Provas er inddragende og støttende, og der er en tydelig involvering af medarbejderne, så alle udvikler sig med opgaverne og i fællesskab finder de bedste løsninger.      I Provas arbejdes der både med hovedet og med hjertet. Derfor lægges der stor vægt på, at medarbejderne har talent for at lytte, samarbejde og anerkende et godt argument.         Dit nye job er en nøglerolle …   Som leder af vores genbrugs

title: 푸드CX팀장
description: 구분: 경력(7년이상)       [조직소개]     CX센터는 우아한형제들의 모든 서비스에 대한 CX(Customer Experience) 정책을 직접 설계하고, 운영 구조 전반을 주도적으로 개선합니다. VOC와 데이터를 바탕으로 서비스 구조를 바꾸는 일을 합니다.    푸드CX팀은 배달의민족 푸드 서비스를 이용하는 고객·사장님·라이더의 상담 경험을 책임지는 조직입니다. 콜·채팅·AI 상담 채널을 운영하고, 민원이 생기는 원인을 찾아 서비스와 정책을 바꾸는 일까지 함께 합니다. 같은 문의가 다시 생기지 않는 구조를 만드는 것이 팀의 목표입니다.    이 포지션은 눈앞의 문제를 해결하는 데서 멈추지 않고, 근본적인 개선과 구조 설계로 고객 경험과 운영 효율을 함께 끌어올립니다.           [업무내용]     1. 문의량 자체를 줄이는 운영 환경·정책·시스템 개선 과제 주도      - VOC·문의 유형·리드타임 분석을 통한 인입 구조 문제 발굴, 반복·오류 문의 원인 분류 및 개선 우선순위 설정      - 개선 아이템별 임팩트 정의·분석 및 근거 기반 개선안 유관 부서 제안      - 상담 프로세스·어드민 기능·정책 개선을 통한 불필요한 문의 유입 차단, FAQ·챗봇·AI 상담 등 고객 자가 해결 경험 향상      - 개선 과제 커뮤니케이션·실행 리딩, 배포 이후 효과 검증 및 후속 과제 연계    2. CX프로덕트실과 협업한 운영 문제의 제품·정책 반영      - 데이터로 발견한 문제의 화면 플로우·기능 정의서 등 프로덕트 조직이 이해할 수 있는 형태로의 구체화      - 상담 시스템 전환·고도화, AI 상담 확대, IVR(자동응답) 개편 과정의 운영 요구사항 정의·반영 및 전환 시점 운영 리스크 사전 점검    3. 중대 이슈 선제 대응 체계 수립      - 여러 주체가 얽힌 복합 이슈 대응 및 재발 방지를 위한 운영 체계 재설계      - 리스크 조기 감지 방법 및 에스컬레이션 경로 설계·운영      - 신규 유형 민원 대응 기준 수립·문서화를 통한 구성원 간 판단 기준 일원화    4. 유관 조직 협업을 통한 과제 실행력 확보      - 사업·정책·프로덕트·딜리버리 등 유관 조직과의 협업 및 공감대 기반 과제 완수      - 운영 성과 정기 리뷰 및 리더십 커뮤니케이션, 지표 변동 시 문의 유형 구성 변화와 실제 성과 변화를 구분한 원인 설명    5. 팀 빌딩 및 구성원 육성      - 구성원 코칭·성과 관리 및 팀 내 우선순위 정렬      - 정답 제시보다 판단 기준과 맥락 제공을 통한 구성원의 자율적 문제 해결 지원      - 차기 리더 후보 육성           [지원자격]     - CX·고객센터 운영 분야 7년 이상 경력    - 고객 여정·상담 흐름·인입 구조에 대한 깊은 이해    - 고객센터·상담 운영 조직 리딩 경험    - 운영 비효율을 데이터로 진단해 정량적 개선 성과를 만들고, 그 개선이 유지되도록 구조를 설계한 경험    - 복잡한 상황을 구조적으로 정리하고 명확하게 커뮤니케이션하는 역량           [우대사항]     - 푸드 또는 커머스 플랫폼 CX 경험    - 여러 플랫폼·서비스 병행 운영 또는 그에 준하는 복잡도의 운영 경험    - 100명 이상 규모 CX 조직에서 운영기획·서비스기획·VOC 개선 프로젝트를 주도한 경험    - 조직 개편·업무 이관 과정에서 운영을 안정적으로 유지한 경험    - 상담 시스템 또는 AI 상담 도입·운영 경험    - 2차 민원(에스컬레이션) 대응 경험    - 이해관계가 상충하는 다수 조직 간 조율을 통해 합의를 도출한 경험    - 제품·정책 조직과 협업해 운영 개선을 시스템·정책으로 정착시킨 경험    - 문제 정의부터 개선 실행, 효과 검증까지 완결한 개선 사이클을 문의량 감소 등 정량 성과로 연결한 경험

title: Assistant Manager - Front Office
description: Company Description   'Work your way' to Manukau!  The Sebel Auckland Manukau is a stylish and convenient luxury property. Nestled in the heart of Manukau, just a short 15-minute drive from Auckland Airport and within walking distance of New Zealand’s largest theme park, Rainbow’s End. With easy access to Auckland City, The Sebel Manukau is the ideal base for both business and leisure traveller's. We are a small, friendly group of unique individuals who encourage each other to be welcoming, authentic and inclusive in order to create a positive work environment. For our guests, our aim is to always strive for the highest standards of service in order to give them the very best experience, every time they walk into our hotel.  We are looking for a service centred extraordinaire, who is passionate about our guests, creating memorable moments and leading a team, working closely with the Front Office Manager. This exciting opportunity as our  Assistant Manager,  could be your next step in forging a career with us. Become a strong advocate for Accor Live Limitless (ALL) loyalty program and being proactive in driving strong results with the team.    Additionally you will have a vibrant, and outgoing personality, great attention to detail and a passion for the hospitality industry.   Qualifications     Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in the hotel industry.  Strong administrative abilities and fluency in both written and spoken English.  Possess a strong background in Front Office procedures and Opera PMS.  Demonstrated leadership abilities, outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.  Availability to work on a rotating shift roster (mornings, afternoons and evening).  Full, clean Driver’s License.  Current Manager’s Certificate. title: Jefe/a de Servicio al Cliente - Colmenar
location: Colmenar Viejo, Community of Madrid, Spain
description: Si, como nosotros, trabajas mejor cuando se confía en ti, súmate a nuestro equipo >>   Porque en Elis sabemos que podemos contar con las personas que reclutamos, les damos responsabilidades, les formamos y les ayudamos a crecer. ¡Creemos en ti y en el poder del equipo para lograr nuestros objetivos!  Unirse a Elis significa también elegir un grupo francés con presencia internacional, sólido, humano y comprometido con la economía circular desde hace más de 75 años. ¿Nuestra misión? Alquiler y mantenimiento de artículos textiles, de higiene y bienestar para profesionales. ¡Y hacemos todo esto combinando siempre altos estándares con nuestro enfoque de RSC!   ¿Te apasiona liderar un equipo para ofrecer un servicio de atención al cliente impecable?   Don't choose Elis si no disfrutas de resolver problemas con rapidez, liderar un equipo dinámico y brindar una atención al cliente excepcional.   Si te motiva mejorar continuamente la experiencia del cliente, liderar equipos de reparto orientados a ofrecer un servicio de calidad y te satisface ver cómo cada consulta o incidencia se resuelve de forma eficiente, ¡esta oferta es para ti!   Como  Jefe/a de Servicio al Cliente  en nuestra empresa, tendrás las siguientes responsabilidades:    Liderar y motivar al equipo de repartidores y servicio al cliente, asegurando su desarrollo profesional y el cumplimiento de los más altos estándares de servicio.  Garantizar que todas las interacciones con los clientes se gestionen con rapidez, eficiencia y cortesía, cumpliendo con los tiempos de respuesta establecidos.  Coordinar y supervisar la resolución de incidencias, quejas y consultas, asegurando la satisfacción del cliente en cada etapa.  Colaborar con otros departamentos (como producción, expediciones y ventas) para asegurar una experiencia de cliente fluida y sin interrupciones.  Implementar y monitorizar indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPIs) para mejorar la calidad del servicio y la eficiencia del equipo.  Desarrollar e implementar estrategias para mejorar la experiencia del cliente, garantizando que se superen sus expectativas.  Preparar informes periódicos sobre la actividad del departamento y las áreas de mejora.  Estar en contacto directo con los clientes clave para garantizar que reciban el mejor servicio posible.     ¿Qué buscamos?     Formación en áreas de administración, logística o similar.  Experiencia de 4-5 años en un rol de gestión de servicio al cliente, preferiblemente en sectores industriales y/o de servicios.  Capacidad para liderar y motivar a un equipo, resolviendo problemas de manera eficaz y bajo presión.  Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, con capacidad para gestionar tanto la atención directa a clientes como la coordinación interna con otros departamentos.  Orientación a resultados, con capacidad para implementar mejoras y gestionar KPIs.  Flexibilidad horaria para adaptarse a las demandas del servicio.  Experiencia con sistemas de gestión de clientes (CRM) y otras herramie

title: Customer Care Manager
description: About Olala!   Olala! is an international hospitality and real estate group, developing, owning, and operating hotels, vacation rentals, and food & beverage concepts worldwide.  Since 1996, we have built a presence in 17 cities worldwide, combining global expertise with local insight. Our mission is to deliver smart, technology-driven, and design-forward accommodations that meet the needs of today’s traveler while upholding the highest standards of service.   Your role   We are looking for a strategic, guest-obsessed Customer Care Manager to join our headquarters in Barcelona and lead a team of 4 Customer Care professionals and an externalized team. You will safeguard and elevate the guest experience worldwide across our three business lines: Hotels, Vacation Rental units and Food & Beverage outlets.  This is a senior, people-leadership role for someone with strong operational sensibility, a passion for hospitality, and a proven ability to connect strategy, technology and service excellence.  You will own the full guest experience lifecycle — from pre-booking to post-stay — ensuring every touch point is intentional, frictionless and aligned with our brand DNA, whether the guest is staying in one of our hotels, an apartment or dining in one of our restaurants.  You will work cross-functionally with Ops, Tech, Sales, Revenue, Marketing, Product and F&B teams to translate guest insights into action, optimize performance, and foster long-term loyalty.   Your Journey     Lead, coach and develop a team of 4 Customer Care agents based in the Barcelona office: set objectives, plan shifts and coverage, run 1:1s and performance reviews, and build a strong service culture.  Lead the end-to-end guest journey strategy across Hotels, Vacation Rentals and F&B, defining key moments, pain points and opportunities for delight in every brand and destination.  Ensure 24/7 multichannel guest support (phone, email, chat, WhatsApp, OTA messaging) with clear response and resolution time standards.  Develop and implement scalable Customer Care processes and SOPs adapted to each business line, ensuring consistency, efficiency and excellence in every market.  Own guest satisfaction KPIs (NPS, online reviews and ratings on Google, TripAdvisor, Booking.com and Airbnb, FCR, FRT, complaint resolution time, repeat rate) and drive continuous improvement based on data and qualitative insights.  Act as the senior escalation point for high-impact guest cases, compensations and incidents, and lead root-cause analysis to avoid recurrences.  Partner with Tech/Product to design and evolve guest-facing tools (guest app, automated communications, CRM, chatbots, feedback loops, AI tools).  Work closely with Hotel Front Office, Vacation Rental Operations (check-in, housekeeping, maintenance) and F&B managers to ensure a seamless experience across all touch points. title: Key Account Manager - Marketplace

description: Summary  Vil du utvikle noen av Wennstrom Solutions & Service sine viktigste kunder og skape nye forretningsmuligheter i et markedsledende selskap med tydelige vekstambisjoner? Som Key Account Manager får du kombinere teknisk løsningssalg, strategisk kundeutvikling og prosjektoppfølging i en sentral rolle med stor påvirkningskraft.   Company Profile   Wennstrom Solutions & Service er en ledende nordisk tjenesteleverandør innen løsninger for flytende drivstoff, e‑mobility og teknisk infrastruktur. I Norge omsetter selskapet for 400 millioner kroner og har rundt 90 ansatte fordelt på et landsdekkende serviceapparat og kontorer i Lier, Lillestrøm og Tromsø. Vi leverer kritisk service, vedlikehold og installasjoner som sikrer høy oppetid og stabil drift for våre kunder, innen alt fra tank- og pumpeteknologi til ladeanlegg, nødstrøm og beredskapsløsninger.   Job Description  Som Key Account Manager får du en sentral rolle i Wennstroms videre vekst. Du får ansvar for å utvikle noen av selskapets viktigste kunder innen flytende drivstoff og nødstrøm/back-up power, samtidig som du skal identifisere og realisere nye forretningsmuligheter. Rollen passer for deg som motiveres av å skape resultater, utvikle langsiktige kunderelasjoner og finne gode tekniske og kommersielle løsninger i samarbeid med kunden.  Du vil ha et helhetlig ansvar for oppfølging og utvikling av egen kundeportefølje, samtidig som du skal drive nysalg mot nye kunder i drivstoffmarkedet. En viktig del av rollen blir å forstå kundenes behov og omsette disse til konkrete løsninger, kalkyler og tilbud. Du følger opp tilbud, aktiviteter og leveranser og sikrer god fremdrift og kundedialog. I tett samarbeid med selskapets tekniske fagmiljøer, prosjektledelse og serviceorganisasjon bidrar du til at kundene får gode og helhetlige løsninger gjennom hele leveransen. Du har kommersiell teft, pågangsmot og gjennomføringskraft og motiveres av tydelige salgsresultater. Samtidig er du relasjonssterk og tillitsskapende, med evne til å forstå kundenes behov og omsette dem til gode tekniske og kommersielle løsninger. Du arbeider selvstendig og tar ansvar for egne resultater, men trives også med å koordinere leveranser og samarbeide tett med kolleger på tvers av fagområder.  Du får en sentral kunderolle i et markedsledende selskap med solid økonomi og tydelige vekstambisjoner. title: Afdelingschef til Kunder og Marked hos Midttrafik
description: Kan du komme hele vejen rundt om kundens rejseoplevelse?       Kunderne skal kunne regne med Midttrafik hver eneste dag. Som afdelingschef for Kunder og Marked i Midttrafik leder du fire velfungerende teams, følger den strategiske retning for en driftsfokuseret afdeling og sikrer, at kundens perspektiv har en stemme i vores beslutninger.      Midttrafik er et fælleskommunalt trafikselskab, ejet af 18 kommuner og Region Midtjylland. Vi sikrer kollektiv trafik, der hænger sammen i hele regionen. Hos os er visionen klar: Vores kundefokus skaber nem, attraktiv og bæredygtig mobilitet for alle passagerer. Og her kommer du så ind i billedet som afdelingschefen, der fortsat holder visionen og kunden i fokus.      Opgaven, du træder ind i   Kunderne møder hver dag Midttrafik i telefonen, på skærmene og ude på ruterne. Med Strategiplan 2025–2028 har afdelingen fået en klar retning: Kunderejsen skal være nem, tilgængelig og forståelig før, under og efter turen.     Som afdelingschef får du ansvaret for, at afdelingen lever op til den ambition – både i den daglige drift og i den videre udvikling. Du bliver også en del af et chefteam med direktør Lars Berg i spidsen, hvor du sammen med to chefkollegaer er med til at sætte retningen for hele Midttrafik.      Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at    lede afdelingen Kunder og Marked gennem tre teamledere og have direkte ledelse af Markedsføringsteamet på fire personer  omsætte Strategiplan 2025–2028 til konkrete handlingsplaner og prioriteter og følge op på, at afdelingen leverer på dem  sikre stabil drift og tydelig kommunikation til kunderne, også når driften bliver forstyrret  drive den digitale udvikling i afdelingen sammen med IT & Digitalisering, så kunderne oplever nemme og sammenhængende digitale løsninger  have ansvaret for afdelingens budget, business cases, projekter og leverandørkontrakter – og samarbejde tæt med dine to chefkollegaer om Midttrafiks samlede prioriteringer  være sparringspartner for direktøren, når organisationens vigtigste beslutninger skal træffes      Det er et forholdsvis ungt lederteam, der sætter pris på en chef, som giver sparring og plads, viser vejen og hjælper med at prioritere de mange vigtige opgaver. Du står i spidsen for en afdeling med høj faglighed, så der er plads til at fokusere på den langsigtede udvikling og ledelse.  Samtidig skal afdelingen udvikle sig i takt med kundernes behov og de digitale muligheder – med blik for, at faglighed og personlig kontakt fortsat gør en stor forskel for kunderne.      Velkommen i teamet   I rollen bliver du chef for Kunder og Marked, som består af fire teams:   Trafikservice  sørger blandt andet for hurtig og forståelig information til kunderne, når driften bliver forstyrret.   Kundeservice  svarer kunderne på telefon og skriftligt.   Billetkontrol  står for administrationen af udstedte kontrolafgifter.   Markedsføring  arbejder både for, at flere vælger den kollektive trafik, og for at profilere Midttrafiks produkter.     I

Dine ansvarsområder vil være:    Drive pipelinen og det opsøgende salg i salgsafdelingen.  Eje vores CRM og bygge de faser og processer, der sætter salget i system.  Lægge planerne og prioritere vores salgsindsatser og sikre, at de bliver ført ud i livet. Altid med øje for, hvad data fortæller dig.  Finde potentialet blandt vores nye såvel som eksisterende kunder og styrke kunderejsen i et intelligent samspil med vores marketing og de retention flows der tiltrækker, vedligeholder og bearbejder leads.  Gå forrest som spillende træner og selv ringe ud til kunder hver uge.  Sætte retning for de samlede salgsindsatser, coache og salgstræne teamet, så sælgerne bliver endnu dygtigere.       Hvad vi forventer af dig:    Du har erfaring med opsøgende salg og ved, hvordan man arbejder videre med kundeporteføljen.  Du er stærk i CRM, gerne på super user-niveau, og har idéer til, hvordan systemet og processerne skal skrues sammen.  Du er kommercielt drevet og forstår hele kunderejsen.  Du sælger ordentligt og troværdigt – du er ikke typen, der oversælger.  Du taler og skriver dansk, engelsk og tysk uden problemer.       Om Zederkof og teamkulturen   I over 25 år har Zederkof leveret professionelle teltløsninger, møbler og inventar til hoteller, restauranter og eventsteder – kort sagt til steder, hvor mennesker mødes. Vi er en ejerledet grossistvirksomhed med base i Fredericia, hvor vi driver vores showroom og webshops. Efter en større digitaliseringstransformation er vi nu klar til at sætte strøm til vores markedsrette

title: CRM Manager
description: À propos d'Ornikar Assurances ✨   Chez Ornikar, nous accompagnons chaque année des centaines de milliers de jeunes vers le permis de conduire. Cette proximité unique avec 5 millions d'élèves passés par notre auto-école constitue un avantage compétitif majeur : elle nous permet de mieux connaître les jeunes conducteurs que quiconque, de les tarifer plus finement, et de leur offrir une expérience d'assurance à la hauteur.  Nous avons récemment enrichi notre gamme avec la MRH et l'assurance Chien & Chat, pour accompagner nos clients au-delà de l'auto, tout au long de leur vie.  Dans ce contexte, le CRM joue un rôle central pour relever deux enjeux prioritaires :    construire un parcours Auto seamless qui maximise l'acquisition, l'activation des nouveaux assurés (validation des pièces, onboarding) et la rétention au renouvellement  développer le cross-sell entre nos produits pour maximiser les ventes et la fidélité client    Nous renforçons notre équipe CRM Assurance et recherchons la personne qui, aux côtés d'un·e pair CRM Manager déjà en poste, portera ces enjeux au quotidien.   Nous recherchons un·e CRM Manager 🚨   Rattaché·e à la Head of CRM & Marketing Client, vous portez en propre l'ensemble du périmètre CRM Assurance, aux côtés d'un·e pair CRM Manager. Vous travaillez au quotidien avec les squads Produit, Data et Growth.  Rejoindre l'équipe CRM d'Ornikar, c'est évoluer dans une scaleup où le CRM n'est pas une fonction support mais un pilier de croissance, dans un environnement exigeant, orienté performance, où l'exécution et l'impact priment.   Vos missions 🎯    Faire scaler le parcours CRM Auto   Notre premier levier de valeur : offrir aux nouveaux assurés Auto une expérience fluide, de la souscription au renouvellement. Une base de parcours existe déjà, votre rôle est de la faire passer un cap.   Concrètement, Vous :     Optimisez les parcours d'activation post-souscription (validation des pièces, premier prélèvement, onboarding) pour améliorer significativement le taux de validation de police  Renforcez la conversion devis → contrat via des campagnes de relance et de nurturing plus fines  Construisez les parcours de rétention et de renouvellement pour maximiser la fidélité à l'issue de la première année  Portez le test & learn sur ces parcours : hypothèse, dispositif, mesure d'incrémentalité, décision     Développer le cross-sell entre nos produits   Notre second levier de croissance : transformer nos clients mono-produit en clients multi-équipés (Auto + MRH + Chien & Chat).   Concrètement, Vous :     Identifiez et exploitez les moments propices au cross-sell (déménagement, sinistre bien géré, échéance, événements de vie)  Construisez les parcours d'activation et de nurturing cross-produits  Orchestrez les campagnes cross-sell avec les autres communications pour maintenir une pression marketing maîtrisée  Mesurez la contribution du cross-sell CRM à la croissance et à la LTV     Délivrer les cycles CRM au rythme des featu

title: Responsable CRM & Fidélisation
description: SCANDALE (anciennement Maison Close) est une maison française de lingerie et de prêt-à-porter qui célèbre l'audace, l'exigence et la créativité. Notre ambition : offrir une expérience digitale premium et innovante à travers nos sites e-commerce, nos marketplaces et l'ensemble de nos points de contact digitaux.     Au sein de l'équipe digitale, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la directrice digitale afin d’accompagner la croissance de la marque grâce aux leviers CRM.       Contexte du poste      Notre activation CRM repose sur l’exploitation de la donnée client centralisée dans un Power BI (branché à Klavyio et Shopify). Nous disposons d'une base riche, dont une base active significative, qu’on doit aujourd’hui piloter stratégiquement pour la transformer en actions concrètes et rentables, cohérentes avec notre image de marque.  Pour cela, nous recherchons un·e CRM Manager pour prendre en main ce pilotage et faire vivre notre programme de fidélité Close to You.      Vos missions       Stratégie CRM & pilotage par la donnée (PowerBI, Klavyio)    Analyser la base client pour identifier les segments à fort potentiel et construire une feuille de route d'actions priorisées par ROI  Définir et suivre les KPI clés : taux de conversion, taux de réactivation, taux de churn, CLTV, coût par contact actif...  Arbitrer les priorités entre acquisition, réactivation et fidélisation en fonction de la rentabilité réelle des actions  Accompagner le.a chargé.e de CRM sur les ciblages des campagnes CRM fonction de la segmentation    Lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo)    Concevoir, déployer et optimiser les flows : bienvenue, post-achat, panier abandonné, winback, programme VIP...  Construire et exécuter des tests A/B pour améliorer en continu la performance des campagnes  Veiller à la cohérence de chaque communication avec l'identité et le ton premium de la marque    Programme de fidélité Close to You (Yotpo)    Piloter et faire évoluer le programme dans son ensemble  :  mécaniques de récompense, paliers, communication dédiée aux membres  Analyser la performance du programme (taux d'adhésion, impact sur la fréquence et la valeur d'achat) et proposer des évolutions  Intégrer pleinement Close to You dans la stratégie CRM globale, comme un levier de rétention à part entière et non un outil isolé  Accompagner la migration du programme sur un nouvel outils (S1 2027)    Reporting & ROI (PowerBI, Klavyio)    Mettre en place un reporting mensuel clair et orienté résultats : CA généré, ROI par campagne, évolution des KPI       Profil recherché    4 à 6 ans d'expérience en CRM / lifecycle marketing / retention, idéalement en environnement DTC e-commerce (mode, beauté, lingerie ou lifestyle premium appréciés)  Maîtrise de Klaviyo (ou équivalent) et bonne aisance avec Shopify  Capacité à lire et exploiter des données Power BI sans dépendre systématiquement d'un·e analyste  Track record démontrable d'actions CRM rentables — CA attribué, taux de conversion, LTV

title: Customer Success Manager - Marché France & Espagne (H/F)
description: Flynt aide les restaurants à piloter leur performance sur les plateformes de livraison (Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat). Nous analysons en continu leurs ventes, leurs promotions et leurs annonces sponsorisées pour leur recommander précisément les bonnes actions, puis mesurer leur impact sur leur rentabilité.  Plus de 2 000 restaurants nous font déjà confiance. Nous construisons le Customer Success de demain : piloté par la donnée, outillé par l’IA et centré sur les décisions qui ont un vrai impact pour nos clients. En rejoignant l’équipe Customer Success, tu occuperas un rôle hybride entre accompagnement client, analyse de la performance et développement commercial, avec un impact direct sur la réussite de nos clients.  Ton périmètre  Selon ton profil, tu piloteras un portefeuille de comptes 100 % France, ou un portefeuille mixte France / Espagne si tu es à l’aise pour travailler au quotidien en espagnol.  Ta mission  Faire de chaque client un restaurateur qui pilote vraiment sa rentabilité et sa visibilité sur les plateformes, en t’appuyant sur la donnée et sur nos outils IA pour aller plus vite et plus loin. Ta mission s’articule autour de 4 axes :   1. Formation & accompagnement     Être l’expert du revenue management pour tes clients et faire en sorte que l’outil Flynt n’ait plus aucun secret pour eux.    T’assurer qu’ils maîtrisent l’ensemble des fonctionnalités, en particulier celles essentielles à une utilisation optimale, et que leur paramétrage soit adapté à leurs spécificités.    Construire avec eux une stratégie de rentabilité et leur proposer des scénarios concrets.       2. Pilotage de la performance & data     Analyser régulièrement les performances de tes clients (ventes, promotions, annonces sponsorisées…) pour suivre l’atteinte des objectifs définis ensemble.    Mesurer et présenter le ROI généré par Flynt lors de points de suivi et des bilans stratégiques avec les dirigeants.    Transformer tes analyses en recommandations stratégiques claires et actionnables.       3. Accélération     Utiliser ta fibre commerciale pour proposer de nouveaux produits Flynt à tes clients et leur apporter toujours plus de valeur : détection de nouveaux besoins, démos de nouvelles fonctionnalités, passage à un engagement annuel.       4. Rétention     Fidéliser tes clients et mettre en place des actions pour limiter le désabonnement : suivi des indicateurs de santé client, collaboration avec les équipes techniques pour améliorer le produit, actions de partenariat.      Ta façon de travailler  Chez Flynt, l’IA fait partie du quotidien. Préparation de rendez-vous, analyse de portefeuille, rédaction de recommandations, suivi asynchrone de tes clients : tu t’appuies sur Claude, connecté à nos outils, pour consacrer ton temps à ce qui compte vraiment, c’est-à-dire les décisions stratégiques avec tes clients.   Outils :  Claude, Salesforce, Intercom, Aircall, Modjo, Slack, Notion   Notre offre     Date de début : flexible !    CDI à temps plein

title: Growth Manager - Food Events & Growth

Arbeta nära marknad, försäljning och övriga affärsfunktioner.  Följa upp KPI:er och rapportera resultat till relevanta intressenter.     Vi söker dig som     Har erfarenhet inom growth, digital marknadsföring, CRM eller liknande områden.  Är datadriven och van att fatta beslut baserat på analys och insikter.  Har god förståelse för digitala kanaler och kundresor.  Är självgående, resultatorienterad och affärsmässig.  Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska.     Vi erbjuder   En central roll med stort eget ansvar, möjlighet att påverka verksamhetens tillväxt och arbete i en innovativ och utvecklande miljö. Conpassio har över fyra decennier av gemensam erfarenhet inom search/rekrytering av ledare och specialister samt tillsättning av Interimskonsulter. description: Thon videreutvikler nå lojalitetsprogrammet Thon+ til en felles kunde- og lojalitetsplattform for hele konsernet. title: Enhetschef Kund elnät
description: Du söker nya utmaningar och ett meningsfullt arbete som gör skillnad för människor och samhället. Vi letar efter såna som du, som är fulla av engagemang, nyfikenhet och energi. För att leva och bo behöver vi en infrastruktur, förutsättningar för ett fungerande samhälle. Vi är det kommunalägda bolaget som förser Lidköpings kommun med det som kan kallas den osynliga infrastrukturen. Det handlar om vatten och avlopp, bredband och elnät men också om avfallshantering. Elnätet drivs i dotterbolaget Lidköping elnät AB. Våra 120 medarbetare har hög kompetens inom allt från teknik, drift och säkerhet till ekonomi och miljö.      Vårt uppdrag har en betydande roll i kommunens arbete med att forma ett hållbart samhälle och att erbjuda god service till medborgarna. Vi hoppas att du vill vara med på resan att forma just det samhället och att erbjuda den servicen till våra kunder i Lidköping – varmt välkommen med din ansökan till Lidköping miljö och teknik!      Ett ledaruppdrag nära kund och verksamhet   Som Kundchef Elnät får du en central roll i en samhällsviktig verksamhet där kundupplevelse, effektiva processer och regelefterlevnad går hand i hand. Du leder cirka 10 medarbetare inom kundservice, debitering, inköp och lager och ansvarar för kundresan från första kontakt till fakturering.      En viktig del av uppdraget är att utveckla arbetssätt och processer för ökad kvalitet och effektivitet. Du rapporterar till Affärsområdeschef Elnät och ingår i ledningsgruppen tillsammans med cheferna för Drift samt Projekt.       Rollen som Enhetschef Kund elnät   I rollen kommer du bland annat att:   Leda och utveckla ditt team mot ökad effektivitet och kvalitet  Säkerställa regelefterlevnad inom debiteringsprocesser och kundhantering  Ta fram förslag på elnätsavgifter för beslut av styrelsen tillsammans med Affärsområdeschef  Driva införandet av effekttaxa – en ny taxa som börjar gälla 2027  Delta i ledningsgruppen och bidra till elnätsverksamhetens strategiska inriktning och utveckling  Utveckla och dokumentera processer för bättre transparens och kvalitet  Deltaga utveckling av kund- och debiteringssystem för framtida behov och samarbeten  Säkerställa leverans till Billingen Energi  Utvärdera och utveckla samarbetsfördelarna med Billinge Energi       Vem är du?   Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av kundnära verksamhet, processutveckling, förändringsarbete och av att leda andra. Du kan idag vara chef, teamledare, arbetsledare eller motsvarande roll där du har ett tydligt ansvar för att samordna och utveckla ett team. Vi ser gärna att du har haft personalansvar i någon tidigare roll.      Erfarenhet från elnäts- eller energibranschen är meriterande, men inte ett krav. Viktigare är att du har förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i lagar, regler och marknadsvillkor och omsätta dem i tydliga processer och arbetssätt.     Du har en för området relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, alternativt motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdig.

title: Customer Success
description: Om Optiplan   Vi är ett produktbolag som utvecklar SaaS-lösningar för samhällsutveckling inom områden som skolskjuts, skolplacering och turbundna resor. Vår vision är medborgarnytta, effektivitet och förenkling i skolans vardag. Med smarta algoritmer och produktinnovationer strävar vi efter att skapa rättssäkra och effektiva flöden som sparar tid och resurser för kommuner. Vår ambition är att kombinera affärsnytta med samhällsnytta i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö där alla medarbetare bidrar till både teknisk innovation och samhällsutveckling. Vi erbjuder även konsulttjänster inom verksamhetsutveckling och optimering.  Vi är sedan 2025 en del av Nordtech Group och befinner oss i en fas av stark tillväxt och produktutveckling.  Nu vill vi stärka vårt Customer Success-team med en kollega som vill bidra till att våra kunder får ut mesta möjliga av våra produkter, och som därmed gör nytta för samhället.   Din roll hos oss   Som Customer Success har du en central roll i att våra kunder får en trygg implementering och en god användarupplevelse av våra produkter över tid. Du följer kunden genom hela resan, från implementation till utbildning och support. Du bevakar hur kunderna använder produkten och hittar möjligheter till förbättring, i nära samarbete med produktutveckling och affärsutveckling.  Du blir en del av teamet för Optiplan Elevresor, som optimerar skolskjutsen från elevens lagstadgade rätt till den faktiska resan: lägre kostnader för kommunen, tryggare resor för barnen och färre körda kilometer.   Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:      Genomföra implementeringsprojekt hos nya kunder: uppsättning, utbildning och användarstöd   Ge support och utbildning till befintliga kunder   Driva dialogen mellan kund och utvecklingsteam vid avtalad systemutveckling   Projektleda konsultuppdrag   Ta fram artiklar och utbildningsmaterial till vårt Hjälpcenter   Delta på användarträffar och testa ny funktionalitet inför release     Din profil   Vi söker dig som vill hjälpa kunder att lyckas genom att lyssna in vad de faktiskt behöver. Du trivs i gränslandet mellan kund, verksamhet och teknik och värnar om samarbetet både inom CS-teamet och tvärfunktionellt med produktutveckling och sälj.  Som person är du nyfiken och vill förstå varför saker fungerar som de gör, inte bara hur. Struktur är viktigt för dig, och du behåller överblicken även när flera kundprojekt pågår samtidigt. Du tycker om att lära dig nytt och delar gärna med dig av det du kan. Hos oss är det lika naturligt att be om hjälp som att ge den.   Vi tror att du har:      Minst 2 års erfarenhet av kundnära arbete med support, utbildning eller implementering av IT-system – hos en leverantör eller som användare/systemförvaltare, till exempel i en kommun   Erfarenhet av att driva eller delta i kundprojekt   Eftergymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet   Mycket god datorvana, särskilt i Excel   Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift     Meriterande:      Erfarenhet från kommun eller offentlig

title: Customer Success Specialist (Turku)
description: Haluatko kehittyä asiakaskohtaamisten ja myynnin huippuosaajaksi? Sytytkö tavoitteista ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti eteenpäin? Motivoiko sinua työ, jossa onnistumisesi näkyvät suoraan sekä asiakkaan arjessa että omassa tuloksessasi?    Etsimme nyt useampaa uutta Customer Success Specialistia Turkuun!   Customer Success Specialistina olet keskeisessä roolissa luomassa sujuvaa ja positiivista asiakaskokemusta. Työskentelet osana uutta tiimiä, jolla on tärkeä tehtävä Elisan asiakaskokemuksen kehittämisessä ja jossa jokaisen panoksella on aidosti merkitystä. Tehtävän keskiössä on asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistaminen sekä niihin sopivien, räätälöityjen ratkaisujen tarjoaminen Elisan palveluiden ja tuotteiden avulla. Tavoitteenasi on auttaa asiakasta saamaan enemmän kuin hän odotti ja tuottaa lisäarvoa sekä asiakkaalle että Elisalle.  Työ on pääasiassa puhelimitse tapahtuvaa asiakastyötä: vastaat asiakkaiden yhteydenottoihin ja kontaktoit asiakkaita myös aktiivisesti myynnillisten ulossoittojen muodossa. Aktiivinen myyntityö on keskeinen osa tehtävääsi, jossa onnistuminen perustuu asiakkaan tarpeiden ymmärtämiseen ja kykyyn viedä tilanne sujuvasti ratkaisuun. Työ on tavoitteellista ja suoriutumista seurataan selkeiden mittareiden kautta, jotka ohjaavat tekemistä ja tekevät onnistumisen näkyväksi.  Tässä tehtävässä jokainen päivä on erilainen tuoden mukanaan mahdollisuuksia uuden oppimiseen ja ongelmanratkaisutaitojesi kehittämiseen. Viihdyt tehtävässä, jos nautit vaihtelevasta tekemisestä, pidät langat käsissäsi vauhdikkaassakin arjessa ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi asiakaspalvelun ja myynnin parissa!   Entä työajat ja palkka?    Etsimme useampaa uutta työkaveria  toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan kokoaikaiseen (37,5 h/vko) työsuhteeseen. Toivomme, että pystyt aloittamaan työt perehdytyksen merkeissä 11.1.2027.   🕙 Työskentelemme vuoroissa ma-pe klo 08:45-18:15 välillä ja odotamme sinulta valmiutta työskennellä näissä vuoroissa.  📍Työskentelypisteesi sijaitsee  Turun   toimistollamme.  Työsuhteen alussa työskentelemme toimistolla sujuvan perehdytyksen varmistamiseksi. Osaamisen karttuessa sinulla on myös mahdollisuus tehdä töitä etänä yhteisiä pelisääntöjä noudattaen. Elisalla on käytössä hybridityön malli, jonka mukaan työskentelemme toimistolla keskimäärin kolmena päivänä viikossa.   💰Tehtävässä varmistat osaltasi asiakaspalvelumme myynnillistä onnistumista, ja me myös palkitsemme sinua onnistumisista ja itsesi ylittämisestä!  Pohjapalkkasi määräytyy ICT-alan TES:n mukaan (2357   €/kk), minkä lisäksi tarjoamme houkuttelevan kannustemallin, jossa ansaintamahdollisuudet ovat aidosti omissa käsissäsi. Lisäansiot vaihtelevat tyypillisesti muutamista sadoista aina useisiin tuhansiin euroihin kuukaudessa!    Mitä toivomme sinulta?   Me uskomme, että asiakaskohtaamisten ammattilaiseksi kasvetaan oppien ja kokemuksen kautta. Emme siis odota sinun olevan valmis ammattilainen – innostus ja motivaatio vievät pitkälle! Arki on ajoittain nopeatempoist

Samtidig driver du en portefølje af tværgående indsatser, hvor medarbejdere fra hele organisationen samarbejder om at løse vores vigtigste opgaver. Vi arbejder ud fra princippet test, lær og skaler det der virker med fokus på effekt og værdi. Rollen indebærer både personaleledelse i egen kompetenceenhed for pt. 19 medarbejdere og sponsoransvar i tværgående projektteams, der driver og udvikler vores sundhedstilbud.
