description: We’re looking for a  Head of Customer Operations B2C  to join us at Telia Norway.  I’m John Sebastian Schmidt Slørdahl, Head of Consumer, and I’m searching for an experienced and ambitious leader ready to take our B2C customer operations to the next level. Our B2C customer operations consist of around 300 great colleagues across our brands (Telia, OneCall, Mycall) and products (mobile, broadband, TV).  You will lead a large customer-facing organization with a clear ambition: deliver great customer experiences while transforming how we operate and strengthening the commercial value we create in every customer interaction.   What You’ll Do   You will have end-to-end responsibility for B2C Customer Operations, combining strong operational leadership with a significant transformation agenda.    Lead and develop our B2C customer operations, ensuring high-quality customer experiences and efficient operations at scale.  Drive a major transformation of customer operations, simplifying and standardizing how we work while accelerating digitalization, automation and the use of AI.  Strengthen the commercial role of customer operations, increasing value creation through sales, retention, loyalty and a stronger focus on customer lifetime value.  Build a high-performing organization by developing leaders and employees and creating strong engagement, accountability and a culture of continuous improvement.    The role can be based in Oslo or Trondheim, with regular presence across both locations expected.   What Will Help You Thrive In This Role   We are looking for an experienced leader who combines strong operational expertise with the ability to transform, engage and deliver commercial results. You know what excellent customer operations look like, but you are equally motivated by building what comes next.    Significant leadership experience from large-scale customer operations, customer service or other complex service operations, with responsibility for people, customer experience and operational performance.  Proven experience leading leaders and larger organizations, with a strong track record of building engagement, accountability and high-performing teams.  Demonstrated success in leading significant transformation, including changes to operating models, processes, technology and ways of working.  Strong commercial understanding, with experience connecting customer interactions to sales, retention, loyalty and customer lifetime value.  A strong customer orientation, with demonstrated ability to improve customer experience while balancing quality, efficiency and commercial outcomes.  Good understanding of digitalization, automation and AI, and how technology can fundamentally improve customer operations.  Relevant higher education is preferred, for example within business, economics, technology or a related field. Extensive and relevant leadership experience may compensate for formal education.  Fluency in Norwegian and English.     Join us

title: Head of Key Accounts  - On Trade
description: Vil du lede Red Bulls viktigste kundrelasjoner i en av våre raskest voksende kanaler?    Som Head of Key Accounts - On Trade får du ansvar for våre største kunder innen  bar, restaurant, hotell, kantine, vending, event og uteliv  – kanalen som er selve kjernen i Red Bulls merkevare og vekst i Norge. Rollen kombinerer strategi, forhandlinger og kommersiell gjennomføring.  Du blir en del av  On Trade-ledergruppen i Norge , leder to Key Account Managers og har egne strategiske kunder. Du rapporterer til Commercial Director - On Trade og jobber tett med Field Sales, Trade Marketing, Events og kollegaer i Red Bull HQ og Europa.   Alle ansvarsområdene vi gir deg tillit i:    DRIVE KEY ACCOUNT STRATEGY & COMMERCIAL GROWTH   Utvikle og gjennomføre salgsstrategien mot nøkkelkundene Bruke kunde-, salgs- og markedsdata til å sette tydelige prioriteringer og identifisere vekstmuligheter   BUILD WINNING CUSTOMER PARTNERSHIPS   Lede større kunde- og årsforhandlinger Bygge langsiktige partnerskap som skaper verdi for både kunden og Red Bull og driver lønnsom vekst   LEAD & DEVELOP THE KAM TEAM   Lede, coache og utvikle KAM-teamet, med tydelige mål, prioriteringer og fokus på resultater   Din kunnskap og ekspertise som betyr mest i denne rollen:     Har solid erfaring fra Key Account Management, salg eller kommersiell utvikling – gjerne fra FMCG, drikkevarer, HORECA eller tilsvarende bransje  Er trygg i komplekse kunde- og prisforhandlinger  Kombinerer strategi og gjennomføring – fra data til målbare resultater  Bygger sterke relasjoner og har et godt nettverk i bransjen  Vil utvikle mennesker og lykkes gjennom andre  Behersker norsk og engelsk flytende, både muntlig og skriftlig    Red Bull Norway AS er en arbeidsgiver som fremmer mangfold. Vi har sterk tro på at en mangfoldig arbeidsstyrke er en viktig faktor for suksess. Vi gjør ansettelser basert på den enkeltes erfaring og ferdigheter uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell legning, etnisitet og religion.

title: Palvelupäällikkö, Kontulan ja Myllypuron kirjastot
company: Helsingin kaupunki – Helsingfors stad – City of Helsinki
company_normalized: helsingin kaupunki – helsingfors stad – city of helsinki
description: Haemme palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen alkaen 1.1.2027. Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään eri kirjastoissa, joissa toteutetaan olemassa olevia hankkeita tai suunnitellaan tulevaisuuden palveluja ja toimintatapoja. Ensimmäisen vuoden jälkeen tehtävä jatkuu toisessa aluekirjaston toimipisteessä, jossa on meneillään rakennus-, remontointi- tai muita laajempia kehittämishankkeita.  Palvelupäällikkönä toimit kirjastonjohtajan työparina. Johdat ja kehität toimintaa valmentavan johtamisen keinoin ja rakennat yhdessä henkilöstön kanssa toimintakulttuuria, jossa ihmiset voivat käyttää osaamistaan, ottaa vastuuta ja kehittää työtään.  Toimit kahden tiimin esihenkilönä, sen lisäksi olet alueen johtotiimin jäsen. Tärkeä osa tehtävääsi on vahvistaa yhteisöohjautuvuutta ja luoda edellytyksiä sille, että tiimit löytävät yhdessä toimivia ratkaisuja asiakkaiden ja alueen tarpeisiin.  Etsimme kehittämismyönteisiä ja ihmisläheisiä esihenkilöitä, jotka innostuvat muutoksesta ja näkevät mahdollisuuksia myös keskeneräisyydessä. Arvostamme valmentavaa työotetta, hyvä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin.  Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto.  Valittavalta edellytämme kirjastoalan työkokemusta tai hyvää kirjastopalvelujen ja niiden toimintaympäristön tuntemusta.  Valittavalta edellytämme myös erinomaista suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa, hyvää englannin kielen suullista taitoa tai erinomaista muun kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.  Eduksi luemme aiemman esihenkilökokemuksen sekä kirjasto- ja informaatioalan opinnot.  Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen tehtävän sekä ison työnantajan työsuhde-edut ja kehittymismahdollisuudet.  Kontulan ja Myllypuron kirjastoihin kuuluu Kontulan palvelukeskuksen kirjasto sekä Aapelinkulma, johon on tulossa uusi yhteisö- ja kulttuuritila. Kontulan ostoskeskukseen suunnitellaan myös uutta kulttuuri- ja vapaa-aika toimialan Kontula-taloa, jonne kirjasto siirtyy. Talon on tarkoitus valmistua ensi vuosikymmenen alussa.  Jos sinua innostaa ajatus, että et johda vain olemassa olevaa, vaan olet rakentamassa sitä, mitä kirjasto voisi tulevaisuudessa olla, tämä tehtävä voi olla sinua varten.  Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan tulevaisuuden kirjastoja Helsinkiin!  Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Helsingin kaupunki kannustaa anonyymiin rekrytointiin, ja tämä rekrytointi toteutetaan anonyymisti. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen. Täytä työnhakulomake normaalisti. Huomioi hakemusta kirjoittaessasi, että se noudattaa anonymiteetin periaatteita. Esihenkilö valitsee haastateltavat henkilöt anonyymin yhteenvedon perusteella eikä siinä ole nähtävissä hakijan nimeä, ikää, sukupuolta tai äidinkieltä.  Jätä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta.

title: Head of Account Operations in Amazon PPC Agency
description: Our client, a fast-growing international e-commerce company scaling multiple brands on Amazon, is looking for an experienced  Head of Account Operations  to lead its PPC, Account Management, CSM, and Catalogue Coordination functions. This is a senior leadership role with direct ownership of client retention, account health, team performance, and day-to-day operational delivery.  You'll be the primary client-facing CSM and the single point of operational accountability across the account operations function. You'll make sure the right work is being done by the right people, at the right quality, at the right time - while staying close enough to execution to step in when capacity gaps, escalations, or complex account issues require hands-on support.  This role suits someone who combines strong Amazon expertise with excellent client management, leadership, and operational discipline. You should be comfortable making decisions independently, managing multiple priorities, developing people, and taking ownership of client outcomes without needing constant CEO involvement.   About the Company:   The company specializes in high-performance Amazon account and advertising management, trusted by clients for its precision, insight, and results. With steady organic growth and a small, expert team, this is a strong opportunity to take ownership of a critical leadership function and help build a highly efficient, scalable account operations department.   Key Responsibilities:    Client & Account Leadership     Serve as the primary client-facing CSM, owning client relationships, satisfaction, retention, and long-term account health.  Lead client calls, set agendas, communicate strategy, manage expectations, and resolve escalations.  Translate client goals, requirements, and SLAs into clear priorities for internal teams.  Proactively identify underperforming accounts, relationship risks, scope creep, and resource-heavy accounts.  Identify opportunities to improve client outcomes and support organic account growth.  Maintain strong strategic alignment between client commercial goals and Amazon PPC / Account Management activity.      Strategic Account Management     Set and adapt PPC and Account Management strategy across the portfolio based on Amazon best practices and client objectives.  Regularly review account performance, strategic direction, and key risks.  Ensure PPC and Account Management teams are working toward clear commercial objectives rather than operating in isolation.  Coordinate Catalogue priorities, listing and variation work, and compliance requirements with PPC, AM, and client needs.  Step into complex account situations and provide senior-level strategic guidance when required.      People & Performance Management     Manage, coach, and develop PPC, Account Management, and CSM team members through regular 1:1s, performance discussions, and operational check-ins. Unser Ziel ist es, unserem Publikum täglich Orientierung zu bieten. Das vielfältige Portfolio umfasst neben der «Neuen Zürcher Zeitung» und der «NZZ am Sonntag» zahlreiche weitere Publikationen, Events, Podcasts sowie audiovisuelle Formate.  In einer Schlüsselposition auf Geschäftsleitungsebene übernehmen Sie die kommerzielle und strategische Verantwortung für unser B2C-Wachstum sowie die Maximierung von Kundenwert und -bindung in der Schweiz und in Deutschland. title: Head of Customer Excellence, APAC
description: Who We Are   We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing – and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy – and we know we can’t shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we keep evolving, together.   What We Do   RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 700+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain. Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t rot in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.  We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters straight, and it’s accelerating: the first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history, with new contract value up 83% year over year. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.  In response to our fast growth and market expansion we are looking for Head of Customer Excellence for APAC North to lead an integrated Customer Success and Service Delivery team and be accountable for customer outcomes, service health, retention and growth, and the sustainable economics of the regional portfolio.  You will work where customer strategy, service performance and commercial judgement meet. You will help your teams focus on the right customers and interventions, make clear capacity trade-offs, and coordinate action when a risk is bigger than any single CSM or SDM can resolve.  APAC North brings together significant customer opportunity with diverse markets, cultures, languages, partners and service requirements. You will have the mandate to unite those perspectives, build a stronger regional team and make sure customer growth is backed by reliable service, clear accountability and sustainable ways of working.   What We Need You To Do And Be   Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.        Drive customer outcomes and account health: Own portfolio-level outcomes, health, retention and growth, ensuring customers progress through adoption, value realisation and optimisation, working closely with Customer Success Managers and commercial leaders.   Safeguard service health and continuity: Make sure material service risks are visible, clearly owned and progressed with Service Delivery, Support and technical teams.   Manage service economics: Balance cost-to-serve against customer value, contractual commitments and account complexity, and make delegated commercial decisions within the published contract approval framework, partnering with Sales on pricin

title: Director, Customer Value
description: Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with Customers across every screen.  We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.   The Challenge    We are seeking a Director of Customer Value to act as a strategic partner to senior leadership within Adobe’s most important customers across the Middle East. The role drives measurable business outcomes from Adobe investments, with an emphasis on complex, customer facing enterprises where digital experience, loyalty and personalized engagement are central to growth.  Positioned at the intersection of sales, customer success and delivery, the Customer Value Director takes a long term, outcome led view of the customer journey. The director orchestrates cross functional alignment, establishes value governance, accelerates adoption and communicates business impact. The role is accountable for the value framework and executive narrative, rather than day to day project delivery or commercial ownership. Translate priorities into a joint value roadmap linking prioritized use cases, Adobe capabilities, business owners, dependencies, milestones and measurable success indicators. Tailor value hypotheses to customer economics, such as customer acquisition, loyalty, conversion, digital channel adoption, ancillary revenue and service experience.   Work with the Adobe ecosystem to align engagement plans with strategic account priorities.      Outcome orchestration     Bring together Adobe Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, technical specialists and partners around agreed value milestones and decision points.   Proactively identify risks, misalignment, and barriers to value realization. Coordinate executive escalations when required, ensuring clear ownership, timely engagement from relevant stakeholders, and alignment on resolution plans that protect customer outcomes.   Guide customers through business change considerations, operating model alignment and adoption priorities needed to realize value. title: Head of Saudia Arabia Client Coverage, MD, State Street Investment Management
description: About State Street     Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.  Our promise to maintain an environment where every employee feels valued and is given equal opportunities to meet their full potential regardless of their identity, origin or gender infuses our day-to-day efforts. It’s also part of our commitment to inclusion, development and engagement, and corporate social responsibility. Join us.  At State Street Investment Management, our mission is to invest responsibly to enable economic prosperity and social progress. Our vision is to be the first investment call for every institutional investor and financial intermediary.  In order to achieve SSIM’s Mission and Vision, our Client Coverage Group will drive the sale of a robust mix of innovative solutions to our institutional clients, including active and beta strategies, while delivering a best-in-class service experience within a culture that values diversity, collaboration and learning.    Job Description      Overview of role:   We are looking for an accomplished investment management professional to join our dynamic, diverse SSIM Middle East & Africa (MEA) Client Coverage team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. You will be a key member of the MEA team contributing to our client relationship management, sales and business retention efforts.  You will lead an ambitious and entrepreneurial team of client-facing professionals covering Institutional, Wealth and Intermediary clients in Saudi Arabia, with a primary focus on Sovereign Wealth Funds, Central Banks, Development Funds, Pension Funds, Financial Institutions and Family Offices. Your personal focus will be on Tier 1 clients and prospects. Your product focus will span the full range of existing SSIM capabilities and you will also lead strategic projects and initiatives supporting our business growth and risk excellence efforts in the region.  You will need to collaborate with colleagues in investments, product, research, sales and marketing. The role requires energy, flexibility, curiosity and excellent interpersonal and communication skills.  We want you to develop a deep understanding of the SSIM franchise in the Kingdom and the broader region to anticipate the needs of our clients, manage business at risk and actively contribute to the region’s annual net new revenue targets. This role reports to the Head of Middle East and Africa and is part of the MEA regional leadership team and the SSIM Senior Leadership Team (SLT). title: Client Success Strategist (Mandarin & English Speaking)
description: About the Company   We are partnering with a growing technology company that provides technology solutions for independent restaurants across the US.  Its platform combines AI-powered ordering, delivery enablement, payment solutions, and point-of-sale technology to help restaurant owners simplify daily operations and grow their businesses.      About the Role   We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Client Success Strategist to manage and grow relationships with a portfolio of restaurant clients.  You will act as the main point of contact for assigned clients, helping them get the most value from the company's products and services.  This role goes beyond traditional customer support. You will take ownership of client relationships, drive product adoption, identify potential risks, and work closely with internal teams to improve client satisfaction, retention, and account growth.      Key Responsibilities    Build and maintain strong relationships with a portfolio of restaurant clients.  Take ownership of client accounts and serve as their primary point of contact throughout the post-sales journey.  Coordinate client onboarding and work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth experience.  Proactively monitor client satisfaction, product adoption, and overall account health.  Understand clients' business goals and challenges, and recommend suitable products and solutions.  Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling based on clients' needs.  Identify potential account risks and ensure issues are properly documented, escalated, and resolved.  Collaborate with Sales, Services, and Product teams to deliver a seamless client experience.  Act as the voice of the client by sharing feedback and recommendations with internal teams.  Develop and share best practices to improve client success processes and service quality.       Requirements    Native or near-native fluency in Mandarin Chinese and professional fluency in English, both spoken and written.  Bachelor's degree or higher.  Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts.  Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.  Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.  High sense of ownership, urgency, and initiative.  Ability to build rapport with clients and communicate effectively with different stakeholders.  Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment.  Willing to work night shifts on-site in Kuala Lumpur.       Nice to Have    2–3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or similar client-facing roles, preferably in a high-growth B2B environment.  Previous experience in a startup or entrepreneurial environment.  Experience in the restaurant, hospitality, or consumer services industry.  Strong analytical and data-driven approach to decision-making.  Experience driving customer retention, product adoption, or account growth.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager

title: Technical Account Manager, French speaking
description: About Us   Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.   How We Work   At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values   Bold  in how we dream and innovate   Responsive  to feedback, challenges and opportunities   Accountable  for results and best in class outcomes   Visionary  in future focused problem-solving   Exceptional  in execution and impact  The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a strategic customer advisor and business outcome leader who partners with enterprise customers to drive measurable security value and cyber resiliency. This is a senior, consultative role that operates at the intersection of technology and business strategy—engaging at the CISO and executive level while maintaining the technical depth necessary to guide complex Proofpoint deployments.  The TAM serves as a trusted executive consultant, proactively identifying strategic risks, architecting adoption and value realization plans, and coaching customers on aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security and business frameworks. While the role has evolved to lead with strategic advisory, a strong technical and security software foundation remains essential.  Successful candidates will bring executive presence, commercial acumen, and a proven track record of driving customer outcomes at the enterprise level—combined with deep experience in Linux, messaging, and cloud security environments. Above all, they will have a passion for ensuring a top-quality customer experience.   Your Day-to-Day     Strategic & Advisory (~50%)      Drive business outcomes aligned to customer security and organizational goals, ensuring measurable ROI across the Proofpoint investment.   Serve as a strategic risk advisor—proactively identifying and mitigating renewal, adoption, and security posture risks before they impact the customer.   Act as an executive consultant—building trusted relationships at CISO/VP level, delivering strategic insights and forward-looking recommendations.   Architect adoption and value realization plans that ensure customers maximize the full breadth of their Proofpoint deployment.   Coach customers on cyber resiliency strategy—aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security framework and organizational risk tolerance.   Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning sessions, articulating security value in business terms.      Technical & Operational (~50%)      Mainta

description: About Reap   Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.  Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.  Backed by leading investors including Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.   Role Overview   We are looking for a  Senior Product Manager  to own and scale Reap's client activation and onboarding experience as we expand into new markets and unlock new use cases. Client Activation is the company's #1 objective - this role sits at the centre of it.  You will design onboarding that turns regulatory complexity into a competitive advantage: fast, compliant, consistent client activation across geographies, products, and flow types, built on systems that scale and differentiate Reap in the market.  What You'll Do    End-to-end activation funnels - from application through identity verification, KYC/KYB, AML screening, risk assessment, account setup, and first value. Our core motion is B2B, with consumer use cases alongside it.  The verification and AML stack in-product - identity and entity verification (KYC/KYB), document and registry checks, sanctions and PEP screening, risk decisioning, and controls that keep us audit-ready across jurisdictions.  Vendor and orchestration strategy - select, integrate, and get the most out of KYC/KYB providers, identity verification vendors, and workflow engines.  Scalable onboarding architecture - configurable flows, rules, and decisioning that adapt to jurisdiction-specific requirements without bespoke rebuilds, plus the activation playbook that lets Reap enter new markets and launch new use cases faster each time.  Regulatory-by-design product thinking - partner deeply with Compliance and Legal to translate licensing and regulatory obligations into product requirements that don't compromise client experience.  Cross-functional orchestration - partner closely with Engineering day-to-day, and work across Ops, Compliance, and GTM to remove friction, reduce manual review, and improve conversion and time-to-activate.  Metrics and iteration - own activation funnel metrics (conversion, time-to-activation, verification speed, manual review rates, drop-off by stage and market), run experiments, and drive a roadmap grounded in data. title: Operations Manager
location: Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description: JOB PURPOSE    Tau is a behaviour change business within Taylor's Education Group, working with leading enterprises across Southeast Asia. Most corporate learning is built to be delivered. Ours is built to increase the odds that people actually change how they work.     Every journey starts with a sparking experience that makes people want to work differently: inside organisations that excel at it, reflecting with coaches, or practising in realistic simulations. Then come months of practice in their real work, through the Tau app, until the new way holds.     We carry the backing of Taylor's, one of Southeast Asia's most established education groups: in education since 1969, with around 35,000 learners in institutions in 4 countries, including Taylor's University, ranked in the top 1% of universities globally (QS World University Rankings).     The operations team is the engine room of Tau: it keeps the business running day to day, gets programmes delivered to clients, keeps our key accounts and facilitators well managed, and keeps improving how we work as we grow.     Tau is at an experimental stage. We are testing propositions, pricing, channels and delivery models, and we are growing quickly enough that instinct alone will stop being sufficient. As we scale, the processes that quietly keep a business running (vendor and client registration, delivery reporting, claims, facilitator management) cannot be allowed to become the bottleneck.     This role owns that engine room. You make sure Tau's operational backbone works reliably today, and you build the processes and, increasingly, the agentic AI-enabled systems that let it keep working as we grow. This is a hands-on builder's role: you will design processes that do not yet exist in the form we need, and improve the ones that do.     Best suited to someone who likes structure but wants room to experiment within it, enjoys being a thought partner to clients, facilitators and colleagues rather than just a coordinator, and values what good education does for people and organisations. Build, document and maintain the standard operating procedures that keep Tau compliant and audit-ready.  Act as the point of escalation for operational blockers across the business, and resolve them without waiting to be chased.  Coordinate with Group shared services (finance, legal, procurement) where Tau's operational processes meet Group requirements.       2. Own end-to-end delivery    Oversee delivery of programmes from confirmation through to completion, including logistics, materials, reporting and closeout. title: Customer Onboarding Manager
description: L’Onboarding Manager aura pour mission de cadrer, piloter et assurer l’onboarding des clients sur la plateforme Tenacy, afin de les mettre en succès dès les premières étapes de leur utilisation.  Il ou elle devra comprendre les enjeux, objectifs et cas d’usage des clients, traduire ces besoins en un plan d’onboarding clair, puis réaliser les ateliers qui permettront l’adoption effective de la plateforme.  Le rôle comprend également une dimension structurante : l’Onboarding Manager contribuera activement à l’amélioration continue de nos méthodes, outils, contenus pédagogiques et processus d’onboarding, afin de rendre nos projets plus efficaces, prévisibles et scalables.  Dans un contexte de vente grand compte, chaque client a ses propres enjeux, son organisation, son niveau de maturité et ses cas d’usage. L’Onboarding Manager devra donc trouver le bon équilibre entre standardisation de la méthode et adaptation au contexte spécifique de chaque client.    Comprendre les enjeux métier, les objectifs et les cas d’usage des clients afin d’adapter l’onboarding à leurs priorités.    Cadrer les projets d’onboarding : objectifs, étapes, parties prenantes, planning, risques et conditions de succès.    Assurer l’onboarding en réalisant les ateliers qui permettront aux clients de prendre en main de la plateforme et s’assurer qu’ils comprennent comment utiliser Tenacy au service de leurs enjeux.    Construire et améliorer les contenus pédagogiques nécessaires à l’onboarding : supports de formation, guides, trames d’ateliers, parcours types.    Identifier les patterns récurrents dans les projets d’onboarding afin de standardiser ce qui peut l’être.    Adapter la méthode aux contextes grands comptes, en tenant compte de la complexité organisationnelle, du niveau de maturité et des priorités propres à chaque client.    Contribuer à améliorer le discours, l’approche et les pratiques d’onboarding au fil des retours clients et des apprentissages terrain.    Participer à la structuration d’une méthode d’onboarding plus réplicable, mesurable et scalable. 全国の市区町村様向けに、高品質な住民情報システムを導入し、市民への安全安心なサービスを提供しています。西日本SIグループは、京都、関西、中四国、九州の西日本地区を担当しています。本募集では大阪または京都を拠点として、主に関西・京都地区の大規模自治体を担当していただきます。  【職務内容】 適性および要望を考慮して、下記のいずれかのポジションを想定。 （1）アプリ系プロジェクトマネージャー ・自治体の住民記録や税などの基幹系システムのSI（構築・運用保守）やシステム更新作業について、プロジェクト管理者として活動する役割です。 ・お客様先ではNECの代表として対応を行い、社内ではメンバの作業に対する進捗、品質、課題の管理を実施し、コントロールしていただきます。 ・営業とともに受注に向けた提案活動から、受注後のシステム構築、運用保守まで、プロジェクトマネージャーとしてプロジェクトをけん引する役割を担います。  （2）アプリ系 プロジェクトリーダー（プロジェクトマネージャー候補） ・将来のプロジェクトマネージャーを目指す方を対象としたポジションです。自治体の住民記録や税などの基幹系システムのSI（構築・運用保守）やシステム更新作業について、プロジェクトリーダーとして参画し、プロジェクトマネージャーのもとでチームの進捗・品質管理を担いながら、マネジメントスキルを磨いていただきます。これまでのプロジェクトリーダー経験を活かし、プロジェクトマネージャーへのステップアップを目指す若手の方を歓迎します。  （3）インフラ系プロジェクトマネージャー ・オンプレミスのサーバ・ネットワーク構築やパブリッククラウド(AWS)へのシステム移行など、自治体向けインフラ案件のSI（構築・運用保守）について、プロジェクト管理者として活動する役割です。上記アプリ系と同様に、提案活動から構築・運用保守まで、プロジェクトマネージャーとしてプロジェクトをけん引します。  ※プロジェクト規模は、人数10人~100人、売上1億~数十億程度  【アピールポイント】 ・デジタル庁のDX施策に基づき今後も全国の自治体システムの刷新が活発化していくため、大規模PJのSEとして、スキルを磨くチャンスが将来的にも続きます。  変更の範囲：会社の定める職務  【対象となる方(概要)】 学歴不問  【対象となる方(詳細)】 ＜応募資格/応募条件＞ ■必須条件： ・ITシステム構築において、プロジェクトマネージャーを3年以上経験 （業種、業務は問いません）  ■歓迎条件： ・SI売上1億以上またはPJメンバー10人以上のPJのプロジェクトマネージャーとしての経験 ・プロジェクトマネジメントの資格（PMP、情報処理技術者試験のプロジェクトマネージャー等） ・情報処理技術者試験（スペシャリスト等の高度資格）やAWS（アソシエイト以上）などの資格取得者 ・Oracle、Windowsサーバ等、OS、ミドルウェア関連資格  【勤務地】 ＜勤務地詳細1＞ 関西支社 住所：大阪府大阪市中央区城見1-4-24 NEC関西ビル 受動喫煙対策：屋内全面禁煙 ＜勤務地詳細2＞ 京都支社 住所：京都府京都市下京区四条通烏丸東入ル長刀鉾町8  受動喫煙対策：屋内全面禁煙 変更の範囲：会社の定める事業所（リモートワーク含む）  【アクセス】 ＜勤務地補足＞ title: SAP SuccessFactors Application Manager
description: Desde Setesca Group, consultora especializada en talento y tecnología, buscamos un/a SAP SuccessFactors Application Manager para incorporarse a un grupo consolidado del sector servicios, con una estructura organizativa de gran dimensión y un entorno corporativo internacional.  La persona seleccionada será el referente funcional de las soluciones SAP de Recursos Humanos y tendrá un papel clave en la implantación, evolución y gobierno de SAP SuccessFactors, dentro de un proyecto estratégico de transformación digital del área de RRHH.   ¿Cuál será tu misión?    Liderar funcionalmente la implantación y evolución de SAP SuccessFactors.  Actuar como interlocutor principal entre los equipos de RRHH, IT, partners tecnológicos y proveedores.  Gestionar y evolucionar los módulos de Employee Central, Employee Central Payroll y Talent.  Participar en la definición, digitalización y mejora de los procesos relacionados con Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, PRL.  Coordinar integraciones entre SuccessFactors, SAP HCM, SAP ECC o S/4HANA y otras aplicaciones corporativas.  Supervisar migraciones de datos, pruebas funcionales, validaciones y puestas en producción.  Gestionar incidencias, evolutivos, prioridades y niveles de servicio.  Garantizar la calidad, estabilidad y correcta adopción de las soluciones implantadas.  Identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer nuevas funcionalidades para optimizar los procesos de RRHH.    ¿Qué buscamos?    Experiencia gestionando o implantando soluciones SAP SuccessFactors en entornos corporativos.  Conocimientos sólidos de Employee Central y Employee Central Payroll.  Experiencia funcional en módulos de Talent, como Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Succession & Development, Compensation o Learning.  Experiencia en procesos o soluciones relacionadas con Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, PRL.  Conocimiento de procesos globales de Recursos Humanos.  Experiencia coordinando proveedores, consultoras y equipos multidisciplinares.  Capacidad para traducir las necesidades del negocio en soluciones funcionales y tecnológicas.  Experiencia en integraciones, migraciones de datos, testing y gestión de evolutivos.  Nivel de inglés profesional para trabajar en un entorno internacional.    Se valorará especialmente    Experiencia previa con SAP HCM.  Conocimientos de SAP CPI, SAP BTP o herramientas de integración.  Experiencia en integraciones con SAP ECC o SAP S/4HANA.  Participación en proyectos internacionales o despliegues en diferentes sociedades y países.  Experiencia como Application Manager, HRIS Manager, SuccessFactors Lead o responsable funcional de sistemas de RRHH.    ¿Qué ofrecemos?    Participación en un proyecto estratégico de transformación del área de Recursos Humanos.  Una posición con visibilidad, autonomía e interlocución directa con las áreas de RRHH e IT.  Entorno corporativo internacional.  Proyecto estable y con recorrido de evolución.

title: Key Account Manager UK - AECO Software (m/f/d)
description: Company Description   dRofus, a subsidiary of the Nemetschek Group, is a global leader in providing data management and collaboration solutions for the Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations (AECO) industry. dRofus enables project stakeholders to manage, structure, and synchronize critical building and infrastructure information throughout the entire asset lifecycle. The platform supports data-driven decision-making and project transparency for some of the most complex facilities in the world, including airports, hospitals, and educational campuses.   Job Description   In this role, you will be the trusted partner for a portfolio of strategic customers across the UK built environment sector, with a particular focus on hospital projects. Als Account Executive (all genders) bist du ein zentraler Treiber unseres Wachstums. Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, baust Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf und verantwortest deine Opportunities vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kunden und bestehende Partnerschaften gleichermaßen weiter.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielen und Deals nicht nur begleiten, sondern selbst gewinnen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Die Position ist hybrid mit drei festen Office-Tagen pro Woche an unserem Standort in München-Thalkirchen.

What to expect

  • Build your pipeline: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts und Entscheider, priorisierst deine Targets und baust systematisch eine hochwertige Pipeline auf. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kontakte zu konkreten Opportunities.

  • Understand & qualify: Du führst Discovery-Gespräche, stellst die richtigen Fragen und verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden. So erkennst du, wo Wemolo echten Mehrwert schaffen kann, und entwickelst relevante Business Cases.

  • Own the sales cycle (360° Sales): Du verantwortest deine Deals vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Closing. Du hältst überzeugende Präsentationen, koordinierst relevante Stakeholder und sorgst dafür, dass Opportunities konsequent vorankommen.

title: Microwave Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersec

description:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

title: Director, Payer Marketing
description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About the Role:

Headway is already the largest mental health network for America's leading health plans. Very few marketing leaders get to operate at a scale where their work materially shapes how mental health care works in America. This is that role.

We're looking for a Director of Payer Marketing to build and lead the function that makes Headway the most credible, trusted voice in the room whenever a payer talks about mental health. This is an enterprise B2B product marketing leader at heart — someone who translates narrative to commercial leverage, knows their audience backwards and forwards, and understands how that work builds towards outcomes: deeper relationships, stronger renewals, expanded partnerships, and better terms.

This is a player-coach role for someone who is a builder at heart. You'll set the payer-marketing strategy, build and lead a small, high-caliber team, and work hand-in-hand with our Payer/Commercial, Clinical Strategy, and Provider, Patient & Brand marketing teams.

What you'll own:

  • Set the payer marketing strategy. Define the overarching positioning, narrative, and GTM plan for Headway with health plans. The payer story is never just a payer story; it's the synthesis of everything Headway is doing across the platform.

  • Build the function from zero. This isn't a role where you inherit a playbook — you'll define the operating model, the team structure, the cadences, and the metrics that make payer marketing a true commercial lever. You'll create milestones without being handed a roadmap and build momentum in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.

  • Build the category story everyone wants to be part of.

title: Tech Talent Partner
description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

Why this role is different

The AI startups and scaleups we work with have roles they can’t fill. Not because they haven’t tried, but because they have world-class hiring bars, and it’s genuinely tough.

As a Talent Partner, you own those client relationships end to end. You take a role brief properly, you push back when it doesn’t add up, and you become the person a founder, internal talent partner or hiring manager calls before they’ve even decided to hire. You also own delivery, making sure every client has an amazing experience using Dex, from brief through to signed offer.

We’re an AI-first company, and our talent team is pushing the boundaries of what AI can do in recruitment. You won’t just be using AI tools, you’ll be part of the team working out what great hiring looks like when AI is built into every step.

description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. title: Senior Partner Manager (German speaking)
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Chez Theodo FinTech, notre mission est de rendre la finance plus utile pour les gens, les entreprises et la société. Entité experte en FinTech de Theodo, nous accompagnons nos clients -  des grandes entreprises, des ScaleUps et des StartUps du secteur des services financiers - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société.
 
En tant qu'experts technologiques dans les services financiers, Theodo FinTech livre en un temps record des produits digitaux exceptionnels avec zéro bug et un haut niveau de sécurité. Nous savons intégrer les API de toutes les plateforme

title: Health Solution Architect - CDI Paris - Theodo HealthTech
description:
L’histoire de Theodo et son succès

Depuis 2009, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Notre approche : le meilleur de la technologie, au service de la création de valeur, porté par l'approche Lean.

Notre approche unique est fondée sur 3 principes :

  • nous avons développé des expertises reconnues dans les technologies clés de la conception et du développement produit;
  • quelle que soit l’étape du projet, notre priorité à chaque décision est la création de valeur pour nos clients;
  • nous recrutons les meilleurs talents digitaux et cultivons leur ingéniosité grâce à l’approche lean.

En 15 ans, nous sommes devenus un groupe de plus de 700 Theodoers, organisé en entités spécialisées par technologie (Apps, Cloud, Data & AI) et par industrie (Fintech, Govtech, Healthtech, Consumer Products Goods). En 2025, le groupe génère 100M€ de CA.



Tes missions

La santé se digitalise. Les données de vie réelle explosent. Elles facilitent le soin et accélèrent la recherche, notamment via les entrepôts de données de santé.

Ces données sont extrêmement sensibles et réglementées. Nos clients ont donc besoin de notre expertise pour bâtir des applications sur des architectures Cloud conformes à la réglementation HDS. L'arrivée des LLM ajoute un défi : exposer ces données à des agents pour aider les soignants et les patients, sans jamais transiger sur la sécurité.

Dans notre équipe, tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au service du soin et de la recherche. Des projets utiles, pour des produits qui comptent.

Ton rôle : concevoir, convaincre et déployer

Ta mission est avant tout opérationnelle. Tu conçois, tu présentes et tu mets en place des architectures Cloud qui répondent aux besoins fonctionnels, de sécurité et de conformité de nos clients.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
Build security platforms, not security processes

We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our products, data and engineering platform.

This is a highly technical and hands-on role. You will work closely with Engineering teams to continuously harden our systems while helping design the next generation of our security architecture.

You will operate across two horizons:

  • Strengthen security today: continuously harden our applications, access controls and data-protection mechanisms against evolving threats.

  • Build the privacy architecture of tomorrow: move beyond traditional perimeter and access-control security by designing systems where sensitive data is cryptographically isolated, minimally exposed, and increasingly usable without being directly revealed.

Swile, c’est aussi une ambition forte : devenir le leader de la worktech, en cherchant à adresser, à termes, via nos produits, toute la sphère de la gestion de la vie au travail.
 
Nous misons sur l’innovation technologique, un design soigné et une approche RSE rigoureuse, pour contribuer à améliorer le quotidien des travailleurs et des décideurs, tout en dynamisant l'engagement.
 
Avec plus de 1000 collaborateurs et une présence internationale, notamment au Brésil, Swile a déjà convaincu des millions d’utilisateurs et des milliers d’entreprises.

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques pour rejoindre le département INFRES à Télécom Paris.

Le poste est accueilli au sein de Quriosity, équipe commune à Inria et Télécom Paris, au laboratoire LTCI et au département Informatique et Réseaux (INFRES). Située à Palaiseau, sur le plateau de Saclay, l’équipe bénéficie d’un environnement actif en information quantique et en fondements de la théorie quantique.

Le recrutement relève du projet PIQ « Nouveaux outils algébriques pour les décompositions causales des processus quantiques », sous la responsabilité d’Augustin Vanrietvelde. Il porte sur la phase 1 du projet, pour une durée de 18 mois.

Le projet étudie la conjecture des décompositions causales : tout canal unitaire admettrait une décomposition dont les connexions reflètent fidèlement sa structure causale. L’objectif est de développer des outils algébriques et syntaxiques pour étudier des cas ouverts, construire des décompositions ou identifier des obstructions. La recherche est exploratoir

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

title: Flight Software Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

At The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx - a modular, reusable orbital vehicle for space missions to stations and beyond. Nyx is engineered with the capability to transport cargo and, in the future, humans.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

title: Lead Tech SRE
description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra Cloud is our fully managed SaaS edition of Kestra. Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem.

We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. You decide how the platform should evolve, write it down, split it into work, and ship it with your team.

You would lead a team of three, yourself included. That means you stay hands-on (a large share of your week is Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and incident work) while setting the technical direction, reviewing designs, and dispatching work to two SREs.

You work closely with the CTO, the platform

Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience

  • You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

  • Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

title: Client Delivery Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

title: Software Engineer - Edge & Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective.

By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer

description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

About Edra

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build.


The Role

We're building a learning system that teaches AI agents how enterprises actually work. Our system starts from what a customer already has: knowledge base articles, support conversations, tickets, system logs, and agent traces. From that evidence it reverse-engineers how the business actually runs and writes the process down as instructions a person can inspect and an agent can execute, with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input.

We're looking for AI Research Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You'll work on our agentic learning environment: the loops that turn human corrections and agent outcomes into better knowledge and instructions over time. The job combines applied research with ownership of production systems. You find a failure, form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and ship the fix into real customer workflows.

Our team ships fast enough that we're starting to hit GitHub's rate limits, and infrastructure has to stay a month ahead of that. You'll be in key engineering meetings to ensure our infrastructure is ready before anyone asks, and to catch any decisions that may become infrastructure problems later.

This is not a ticket queue. You'll decide what gets built, push back when a managed service already does what someone wants to hand-roll, and invent when no pattern exists. You'll also write real software, not just the infrastructure code underneath it. We run containerized workloads on AWS and GCP, defined in infrastructure as code, with Postgres underneath. Some of our early infrastructure was built quickly before anyone owned it full-time. Part of the job is untangling that while keeping the team moving.
